title: HR Business Partner - Lucknow
description:
Designation: NA


Location: India Uttar Pradesh Shalimar Logix,Lucknow


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Purpose**


The role is responsible to act as the face of HR at the designated function and provide support on all employee life cycle HR processes in collaboration with key business stakeholders for the employees of the business.

**Key facts:**

* Business growth and expansion have led to the creation of a geographically distributed employee base
* HR presence is seen as a key organizational need in order to
	+ Enhance employee experience and engagement levels
	+ Act as a partner to business
	+ Ensure uniformity of employees’ HR process experience
	+ Identify and flag off potential employee concerns and issues in a timely and proactive manner
	+ Enable a consistent organizational culture
	+ Reduce decision time on employee queries and grievances

**Key Challenges:**

* To manage stakeholder expectations on various HR deliverables such as
	+ Employee Queries on payroll, benefits, and rewards
	+ Recruitment TATs
* To keep abreast with process changes and roll outs by the Corporate teams and ensure uniform coverage within the assigned function
* To identify potential employee risk situations and flag off in a timely manner for necessary action or mitigation
* To provide business relevant employee inputs to leaders while also playing the role of an employee champion
* To drive adherence on HR policies across various geographically spread locations

 **Key Result Areas:**

**Key Result Areas**

 **Supporting Actions**

 **Employee Engagement \&**

**Employee Relations Administration**

  

* Works closely with the business to ensure maximum participation in the employee engagement surveys.
* Evaluates results and identifies post survey actions
* Design programs for areas which need improvement as reflected in engagement scores in conjunction with the Corporate EE team
* Manage employee engagement programs, calendar events, business connects, leadership \& HR connects/ town halls, R\&R and HR communications for the assigned function
* Participates in the design and implementation of various employee relations programs.
* Conducts investigations independently on specific employee issues and brings them to closure in collaboration with relevant stakeholder and by following the appropriate procedures
* Partners with COE and Compliance on sensitive or complex employee situations at the ground level that may have potentially broader risk exposure.
* Works with line managers and employees to address all types of employee relations issues ensuring a balance in representing all parties’ interests
 **Performance Management \&**

**Total Rewards Administration**

  

* Plans, manages and provides support to the Corporate Performance Management Team for the leadership review process and the strategic objectives therein. This includes both annual and mid\-year processes which focus on performance management and talent development
* Provides advice and counsel on performance management issues.
* Partners with business leaders to address performance gaps and facilitates discussions or set up a process to take appropriate action.
* Guides Managers on all aspects of performance management including feedback reviews and performance coaching.
* Assists managers in utilizing Corporate driven rewards programs to motivate and recognize teams for their contribution.
* Partners in the Functional roll out and implementation of the Annual Performance and Pay cycle programs by providing managerial education \& consultation on specific situations and program tool support
* Provides compensation support including salary planning, approval of salary actions, promotions and job re\-leveling
 **Talent Acquisition, on\-boarding \& Induction Operations**

  

* Partners in selection process of lateral hires for Lines of Business by carrying out HR interviews
* Supports the Corporate TA team on Campus Recruitments
* Extends On\-boarding \& induction support for new joiners in conjunction with the Corporate TA team
* Identifies recruitment vendor partners for the Function and supports the sourcing of profiles for Function positions
* Facilitates interview and candidate assessment processes
* Facilitates pre\-joining candidate engagement for prospective hires as per process guidelines
* Manage Induction on new joinees
 **L\&D and Talent Management**

**Operations**

  

* Conducts/ Facilitates specific training interventions related to Communication, HR Process updates, HR policy refreshers, Soft Skills and Team Management etc.
* Partner with managers to retain, develop and motivate people to achieve their fullest potential.
* Partners with business and the Corporate HR team on workforce planning, succession planning, and skills assessment
* Assesses the Line of business’s HR training needs and conducts one on one counseling sessions or facilitates group training sessions as appropriate
* Provides inputs on competencies \& development tools for managers and employees within the Zone.
* Facilitates career management programs at a Zonal level in collaboration with business mangers
* Works with the Corporate Talent Management team to identify Zonal Talent Pool and engage with them on a regular basis through various touch points
* Provides indications of early warning on Talent Pool potential exits and works on mitigating the risk through various employee retention actions in consultation with the Corporate team and Business Managers
 **HR Operations**

  

* Supports effective documentation at the zone of all important personnel documentation such as joining formalities, benefits related inputs, payroll inputs etc in a timely and accurate manner
* Consults with the Corporate Payroll team to clarify employee concerns/ queries related to salaries and benefits administration
* Supports roll out of and awareness building on employee benefits
 **HR Processes \& Policy Compliance**

  

* Implements, administers and interprets \[ when required] corporate policies, programs or procedures
* Ensures adherence to organizational and employee policies
* Builds awareness about policy objectives and procedures
* Supports managers in applying HR policies on moderate to high risk situations.
* Escalates specific situations in a timely manner to Head\- HR for immediate intervention and resolution as appropriate
* Advices on policy revisions and / or creation from a Zonal perspective
 **Stakeholder Management**

  

* Provides ongoing support to the Zone business leaders on human resources related matters, policies and procedures
* Challenges business in specific instances on policy adherence and employee welfare concerns
* Collaborates effectively with external stakeholders such as Labour officers, Auditors, Regulatory Inspectors and vendor partners in keeping with organization guidelines and objectives
 **Employee Feedback \& Exit Management**

  

* Creates forums and facilitate interactions between the employees \& the Zone business leaders on a regular basis
* Gathers informal feedback through relationship building and facilitates grievance management based on insightful feedback
* Manages exit interviews and supports the business in analyzing the data
* Identifies solutions to manage voluntary attrition
 **HR MIS, Audit Requirements \&**

**Reporting**

  

* Provides MIS inputs for key Organization wide HR Dashboards
* Validates Headcount and other critical information metrics against actual representation for the Corporate HR reporting requirements
* Generates analytics of data which can support business decisions (Talent pool lists/ Branch wise employee survey Scorecards/Attrition analysis etc)
* Reviews and analyzes business unit data to identify trends and recommend solutions to improve performance, retention, and employee experience
* Extends all required support to HR audit exercise and takes appropriate action to address observations

title: Branch Manager Gold Loan
description:
Designation: NA


Location: India Karnataka V. A. Kalburgi Plaza, Hubli


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Basic Details:** *Fill the required information about business, unit, location, position, reports to position and date of updation of JD*
===========================================================================================================================================

  

  

  

**Business**  

Financial Services **Unit**  

Aditya Birla Capital Limited **Location**  

Across branches in India**1\) Job Purpose:** *Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)* **(Max 1325 Characters)**
===========================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.*  

**New Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Build strong relationships with local customers, partners, authorities, and community influencers to drive branch customer acquisition. **Managing Existing Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Lead and supervise branch staff including ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE; ensure productivity and performance management **Structuring new Transactions**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure accurate gold valuation, loan structuring within LTV norms, and proper documentation for all new and renewal transactions **Compliance of regulatory guidelines**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards. **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(Max 3975 Characters)**
==========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks

ABC Digital has been incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital in 2023 to engage in distribution of Aditya Birla Capital products and providing services to customers, including web\-based services, e\-commerce, and payments facilities and allied activities.
  

  

ABC Digital is developing an omni\-channel based D2C platform (website and app) to acquire new customers and serve them seamlessly. In addition, ABC Digital has started a virtual engagement management through inbound and outbound calling. Also, ABC Digital is engaged in cross\-selling different ABC products to walk\-in branch customers.  

  

ABC Digital is collaborating with all ABCL subsidiaries to deliver a truly personalized and seamless omni\-channel experience for both new and existing customers by building capacity and enhancing productivity through investments in talent, technology, marketing, and data and analytics.  

  

Job Context  

  

With a large customer base within ABC, there is an opportunity to cross\-sell and upsell our products at an individual level. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering insurance and investment partners as extensions of wealth advisers. ABCDL will not only leverage this large customer base for cross selling opportunities but will also tap into the large Indian population through new age distribution channels for acquiring new customers and cross selling and up selling to them as well as servicing new and old customers. To make this happen, Talent Acquisition Managers will have to ensure continuous supply and retention of talent in the organization across functions/ hierarchies. Their responsibilities will include determining current staffing needs, developing talent acquisition strategies, leading employment branding initiatives, sourcing candidates for open positions, conducting recruitment processes, ensuring positive candidate experiences, and assisting in employee retention and development. Aditya Birla Finance Limited ("ABFL") is a lending subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited. ABFL is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABFL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Dec’20, ABFL has a pan\-India presence with 91 branches and a lending book of Rs. 45,560 Crores.  

ABFL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABFL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABFL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABFL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Job Context**
Collections function carries out monitoring of client wise exposure and portfolio exposure to identify ‘early warning signals’ of stress and to minimize NPAs. This monitoring is done by dedicated teams who specialize in managing delinquent customers who have come under financial stress due to unfavourable market events / changes in business patterns and as well as from those customers who have intentionally stopped payment of dues with mala\-fide intentions. It also carries out overdue loan recovery from defaulting clients.  

The Small ticket segment comprises primarily Digitally sourced accounts with ticket sizes ranging 10k – 5 lacs. This role is responsible for enhancing business profitability through effective management of the delinquent portfolio in the respective zone.  

The incumbent will be accountable for field collections for the customers in the region. For this segment, the collections model would primarily be an Agency Model for flows. We are looking for a professional, friendly, and well\-organized **Front Office Executive** to manage the reception area and provide administrative support. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a pleasant personality, and the ability to handle visitors, calls, and day\-to\-day front office activities efficiently.

As a B2B SaaS Sales Executive, you will be responsible for generating leads, contacting potential customers, understanding their business requirements, conducting product demonstrations and closing sales.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and generate new B2B sales opportunities.
* Contact prospects through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn and other channels.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend the appropriate SaaS product.
* Conduct online product demonstrations and presentations.
* Explain product features, benefits, pricing and business value clearly.
* Follow up with prospects and maintain an organized sales pipeline.
* Convert qualified leads into paid customers.
* Build and maintain long\-term customer relationships.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Maintain accurate lead, follow\-up and conversion information in the CRM.
* Work closely with the product and implementation teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding.
* Identify opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling other products.
* Collect customer feedback and communicate it to the internal team.
* Develop new lead\-generation and sales strategies.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident and comfortable speaking with business owners and decision\-makers.
* Good at understanding customer problems and presenting solutions.
* Passionate about technology and SaaS products.
* Comfortable conducting online demos.
* Strong in communication, negotiation and follow\-up.
* Target\-oriented and motivated by incentives.
* Capable of managing multiple prospects simultaneously.
* Willing to learn new products quickly.
* Comfortable with phone, WhatsApp, email and online meetings.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* B2B SaaS sales
* Software / IT product sales
* CRM sales
* ERP / business software sales
* Real estate technology sales
* EdTech sales
* Digital marketing / technology sales
* Inside sales
* Business development

**Freshers with excellent communication skills and strong sales ability may also apply.**

What You Will Sell

You will have the opportunity to sell multiple technology products across different customer segments, including:

**CRM \& AI \| WhatsApp Automation \| Sales Management \| Real Estate Technology \| Education Technology \| Business Management**

This gives you the opportunity to work with businesses across multiple industries rather than selling a single product.

Performance Expectations

* Generate qualified leads.
* Conduct product demonstrations.
* Maintain consistent follow\-ups.
* Meet monthly sales targets.
* Convert prospects into paying customers.
* Build a strong recurring\-revenue customer base.

Compensation

**Fixed Salary \+ Performance Incentives**

High performers can earn significantly more through incentives based on sales performance.

Why Join Us?

* Sell multiple modern SaaS and AI\-powered products.
* Work with businesses across different industries.
* Attractive performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunity for rapid career growth.
* Learn SaaS, AI, CRM, automation and technology sales.
* Opportunity to grow into **Senior Sales Executive / Sales Team Lead / Sales Manager** roles.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: On the road

**Reporting To:** Service Manager / Head – Customer Support

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience:** Freshers – 5 Years

**Qualification;** ITI / Diploma – Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics or related technical discipline

**JOB SUMMARY**

The **Field Service Technician** will be responsible for **installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and customer support** for company products at customer locations. The role requires strong technical and problem\-solving skills, customer\-service orientation, safety awareness, and willingness to travel extensively. The technician will represent the company at customer sites and ensure **timely service, equipment reliability, minimum downtime, and high customer satisfaction**.

**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Installation \& Commissioning:** Install and commission products according to company standards; perform operational testing, safety checks, and customer demonstrations before final handover.
* **Preventive Maintenance:** Conduct scheduled maintenance, inspect equipment for potential failures, replace minor components/consumables, maintain service schedules, and recommend corrective actions.
* **Breakdown \& Troubleshooting:** Attend customer complaints promptly and diagnose **mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, or electronic faults**; repair/replace defective components and restore equipment with minimum downtime.
* **Customer Support:** Respond professionally to customer queries, provide product\-operation and basic maintenance training, explain best practices, and maintain strong customer relationships.
* **Service Documentation:** Prepare service reports after every visit, record spare parts used, update **ERP/CRM/service software**, maintain installation records, and submit travel/expense reports on time.
* **Spare Parts \& Tools:** Maintain service tools and commonly required spare parts, coordinate with stores for availability, ensure proper use of company assets, and report defective tools/instruments.
* **Quality \& Safety:** Follow company SOPs, safety procedures, electrical/mechanical standards, PPE requirements, and maintain professional cleanliness at customer sites.
* **Travel \& Field Support:** Travel extensively across Tamil Nadu and neighboring states, stay at customer locations when required, respond to emergency service calls, and provide support beyond normal hours during critical breakdowns.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify recurring technical issues, provide feedback for product/service improvements, continuously upgrade technical knowledge, and take ownership of assigned service regions.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

**Technical Skills:** Strong understanding of **mechanical assembly, electrical wiring, basic electronics, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, hand tools, measuring instruments, and technical drawings**.

**Equipment Maintenance:** Ability to diagnose and repair mechanical/electrical/electronic equipment and perform installation, commissioning, servicing, and preventive maintenance independently.

**Problem Solving:** Strong diagnostic and analytical abilities with a practical approach to identifying root causes and resolving equipment failures quickly.

**Customer Handling:** Good communication, customer\-service orientation, professional conduct, ability to explain technical information clearly, and capability to build positive customer relationships.

**Documentation \& Technology:** Basic computer skills with the ability to use **ERP/CRM systems, mobile service applications, digital reporting tools, MS Office, and online communication platforms**.

**Educational Qualification:** **ITI – Fitter/Electrician/Mechanic/Electronics** or **Diploma in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics Engineering**. Industrial maintenance/vocational certification is an advantage.

**Experience:** Freshers with strong technical aptitude may apply; **1–5 years of field service, maintenance, installation, or manufacturing experience** is preferred.

**Mobility \& Work Style:** Willingness to **travel extensively, work independently, stay at customer locations, attend emergency calls, and work flexible hours when required**.

**Key Attributes:** **Technical Aptitude \| Troubleshooting \| Customer Focus \| Safety Consciousness \| Ownership \| Reliability \| Adaptability \| Communication \| Teamwork \| Willingness to Travel**

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
Sprinto is an **Autonomous Trust Platform** that centralizes trust requirements across **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**



Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.



Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve **raised** **$31\.8M** in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over **4,000 organizations across 75 countries**, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With **300\+ native integrations** and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports **200\+ global security standards natively**, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.


**Founded in 2020** by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.


### **Life as a Sprinter \-**



Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.



We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.



Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.



We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.



And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.


### **The mission \-**



Help us build a thoughtful, high\-velocity talent acquisition engine, one that makes it easier for great people to discover us, have an exceptional candidate experience, and ultimately become part of the team.



As a Talent Acquisition Intern, you’ll work closely with the recruiting team across the full hiring process. You’ll get hands\-on exposure to managing candidate pipelines, interview coordination, recruiting operations, and the systems and processes that enable a growing team to hire well.



You’ll have the opportunity to understand how a recruiting function works end\-to\-end, identify what can be better, and help build the systems and workflows that make hiring more effective.



### **Where you'll leave your mark?**


* **Build and manage candidate pipelines:** Keep candidate pipelines organized, up to date, and moving across our ATS system.
* **Create a great candidate experience:** Coordinate interviews, manage scheduling, and ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and clear communication throughout the process.
* **Keep the hiring engine moving:** Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to track candidates, follow up on next steps, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Make recruiting workflows better:** Identify bottlenecks and repetitive processes, and help improve recruitment workflows, systems, and operating rhythms.
* **Bring structure to the process:** Maintain accurate candidate data, recruiting documentation, and reporting so the team has visibility into the hiring funnel.
### **The kind of builder we're looking for \-**


* You **communicate clearly**, thoughtfully, and with empathy — especially when interacting with candidates.
* You **take ownership**: if you see something that needs to get done, you don’t wait for someone else to notice it.
* You’re **detail\-oriented** and understand that small things can have a big impact on the candidate experience.
* You’re curious about how systems work and enjoy learning new tools and processes.
* You have a **bias toward action** and are comfortable figuring things out as you go.
* You naturally spot things that are broken, inefficient, or unnecessarily manual — and want to fix them.
* You are available to **join us immediately**.
* Prior experience in recruiting, HR, operations, or an ATS is a plus — but **curiosity, ownership, and learning velocity matter more.**
### **Inclusion \& Diversity \-**



At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.



We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: IT Support Specialist II
description:
* Bangalore, No. 6/12, Primrose Road, Gurappa Avenue, Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
* **Category:** IT
* **Type:** Full\-time
* **Min. Experience:** Some Experience
**About Betterworks**



Betterworks is HR software to align, develop, and activate your workforce for business growth. Organizations are able to replace outdated, ineffective, universally loathed annual review processes with powerful Continuous Performance Management programs that help managers be better at the conversations, coaching, and development necessary to inspire and motivate the entire workforce to achieve an organization's top priorities today and be ready for tomorrow's challenges.

  


**What You’ll Be Doing**



As the IT Support Specialist II for our internal IT team, you will work with IT leadership to execute a strategy that enables a simple and delightful IT experience for Betterworks employees. You will collaborate on and implement the technical roadmap for IT processes and services that help Betterworks be its most productive, with a focus on automation, simplification, and enablement. Your partnership with internal customers and vendors will be essential to re\-imagining the function of IT and unleashing new ways to work with a globally distributed workforce.


* Serve as the primary Tier 1 escalation point and first responder for IT functions via Slack, our ticketing system, and email — providing real\-time coverage during the UK/India/US East Coast overlap window
* Triage and resolve Tier 1 incidents using our incident management tooling, escalating appropriately when an issue requires deeper technical ownership
* Directly own IT support, MDM, and patch management for Betterworks employees, ensuring quality and timely resolution
* Fully own the end\-to\-end laptop lifecycle working directly alongside our vendor in India
* Maintain up\-to\-date hardware inventory
* Monitor and identify problem trends, propose proactive and well\-researched actions to prevent future occurrences
* Day\-to\-day administration of Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, and other corporate systems owned by IT
* Manage all aspects of the user account lifecycle, including procedures and administration related to onboarding, offboarding, and role changes, ensuring compliance requirements are met
* Participate in a continuous improvement culture; responsible for documentation, standardization, and improvement involving people, process, technology, and helpdesk support services. Regularly update IT knowledgebase, processes, and procedures as needed
* Participate in a customer service culture; responsible for building relationships with stakeholders and end users across all departments, seeking out feedback to ensure we're satisfying the needs of the organization
* Contribute to continuous improvement within IT using service management, metrics, self\-service, knowledge repositories, and other incident\-prevention approaches
* Work alongside IT leadership to implement system changes and execute projects, with occasional direct exposure to wider leadership on cross\-functional initiatives

  




**What’ll Help You Be Successful**


* You love helping people and are empathetic to customer needs
* You have the ability and desire to help others better utilize systems and software
* You have 4\+ years of relevant IT experience, including hands\-on experience managing both Mac and PC endpoints, utilizing MDM
* You have experience with Google Workspace and are familiar with common SaaS applications such as Okta, Zoom, Slack, and associated productivity tools
* You have exceptional communication, time management, and prioritization skills
* You're comfortable working a shifted schedule to provide real\-time overlap with UK, India, and US East Coast colleagues
* You have an experimental mindset that uses data and metrics to back up assumptions and support decision\-making
* You maintain a positive attitude and are a self\-starter who is excited about collaborating cross\-functionally.

  




**What We All Do**


* All employees share the responsibility of being aware of information security risks and adhering to information security policies and procedures.
* All employees are required to participate in information security awareness and training programs.
* All employees have a responsibility to handle data in accordance with data classification and handling guidelines. Employees should be aware of the sensitivity of the data they interact with and follow appropriate security measures.
* All employees have a responsibility of reporting information security incidents in accordance with information security policies and procedures.

  




**What Makes Betterworks Unique**



At Betterworks, we put our people first. To support this, we’ve built a culture and benefits program that prioritize both professional growth and personal well\-being:


* Leadership: Our CEO, Doug Dennerline is a mission\-driven leader with over 25 years of sales leadership experience, making a direct impact on the work people do every day.
* Funding: Backed by $129 million in Series B with top tier investors, including Kleiners Perkins, Emergence Capital, and 8VC.
* Board of Directors: Since the beginning of Betterworks, our board includes industry icons such as John Doerr (who introduced OKRs to Google), Bruce Felt (Founder of Renaissance Software and a trusted advisor to numerous private and public companies), Bing Gordon (Renowned Technology Venture Capitalist with experience on boards like Amazon, Duolingo and Zynga), Jason Green (Founder of Emergence Capital and Greenbridge Foundation) and Gaby Toledano (seasoned executive with nearly three decades of strategic HR and operations leadership at premier enterprise and consumer organizations).
* Perks: We provide company\-sponsored health, wellness, and personal accident insurance. Our remote\-first culture gives you the flexibility to work from anywhere in India, with opportunities to travel and connect as a team. To support your setup, we also offer a one\-time home office reimbursement and a monthly internet stipend to keep you seamlessly connected.
* Product: Recognized by Lighthouse Research \& Advisory and UNLEASH America, Betterworks was named a 2025 HR Tech Award winner for Best Comprehensive Talent Management Solution. We also received Newsweek’s AI Impact Award for Best Outcomes in HR, 2025\.
* Mission Driven: Our mission is to provide the expertise and technology companies need to inspire, develop, and activate their workforce to achieve today’s goals while preparing for tomorrow’s challenges.

  


Connect with us on LinkedIn  


*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse betterworks. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global betterworks Community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Senior Manager, Payroll – APAC
description:
We believe in a world where growth thrives across borders and cultures. Our mission is to guide companies on their journey by providing services and technology that enables global talent management and delivers a human experience.

  



As an Employer\-of\-Record (EOR) provider, we offer the HR and compliance infrastructure essential for companies to expand internationally. We take care of the complex, behind\-the\-scenes work, allowing companies to focus on the strategies that drive their success. We are For People, By People.

  



The future of work is borderless, and so are we. Our people are located around the globe — in the U.S., the UK, India, Colombia, China, and beyond. Diversity and belonging are not just values, they are who we are.

  



We are also committed to making a positive impact. Through our Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) impact initiative, we are addressing our environmental footprint and promoting social responsibility. Our impact program is central to our vision and culture, focusing on employee wellness, diversity, charitable work, and ethical corporate governance.

  



If you are interested in working in a people\-centric, global organization, apply below.

  



We are seeking an experienced and strategic **Senior Manager, Payroll for APAC,** to lead payroll operations across **APAC**. This role will oversee end\-to\-end payroll delivery, vendor performance, compliance, and process optimization to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely payroll execution across the region.



The successful candidate will combine deep **APAC** payroll expertise with strong operational leadership and continuous improvement capabilities. They will partner closely with Global Payroll leadership, Shared Services, HR, Finance, Legal, and external providers to drive operational excellence while supporting broader global payroll initiatives.



This role requires a hands\-on leader who can operate both strategically and tactically, influencing stakeholders at all levels while ensuring consistent, high\-quality payroll delivery across complex, multi\-country environments.



The Senior Manager is accountable for payroll service outcomes across **APAC**, including delivery quality, adherence to compliance, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation. The role owns regional payroll performance and is responsible for driving corrective actions when service outcomes do not meet defined standards.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Regional Payroll Leadership \& Execution**


* Lead end\-to\-end payroll operations across **APAC** countries, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant payroll processing.
* Own regional payroll delivery performance, including accountability for accuracy rates, timeliness, compliance adherence, and service quality outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with country\-specific employment laws, tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Manage Statutory submissions, including year\-end compliance outputs
* Act as the escalation point for complex payroll issues, audits, and compliance matters.
* Lead resolution of complex payroll and employee\-impacting issues, ensuring timely investigation, root cause identification, and sustainable corrective actions.
* Partner with customer\-facing teams to support payroll\-related client escalations and ensure professional, solution\-oriented engagement with customers when required.
* Provide training to Shared Services and other applicable teams to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Establish clear accountability across internal teams and vendors for payroll inputs, approvals, and delivery timelines.


Ensure payroll processes support a positive employee experience by minimizing payroll errors and resolving pay\-related inquiries impacting employees.


**Operational Excellence \& Process Improvement**


* Standardize payroll processes and controls across **APAC** markets to drive consistency and reduce risk.
* Identify opportunities for automation, simplification, and cost optimization.
* Implement and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) with the internal team and LPPs.
* Own performance against defined KPIs and SLAs, including development and execution of remediation plans when targets are not achieved.
* Drive improvement initiatives that create reliable, repeatable, and scalable payroll processes that will support expansion and growth opportunities across **APAC**.
* Utilize operational data, customer feedback, and issue trends to proactively identify systemic gaps and implement preventative solutions.

  


**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management**


* Manage relationships with **APAC** payroll vendors, ensuring strong service delivery, compliance, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Conduct regular vendor performance reviews and lead contract discussions where appropriate.
* Hold vendors accountable to contractual SLAs, service quality standards, and escalation response expectations.
* Partner with Shared Services, HR, Finance, Legal, and IT to ensure seamless payroll integration with upstream and downstream processes.
* Support broader global payroll initiatives, including system enhancements and vendor consolidation efforts.
* Collaborate with customer delivery and account management teams to ensure payroll services meet client expectations and contractual obligations.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**


* Ensure strong internal controls and audit readiness across all **APAC** payroll operations.
* Develop and maintain payroll governance frameworks, documentation, and reporting.
* Mitigate compliance risks through proactive monitoring and partnership with Legal and Compliance teams.
* Support internal and external audits as required.
* Own remediation planning and execution for audit findings, compliance gaps, or payroll delivery risks within defined timelines.
* Ensure clear documentation and traceability of payroll decisions, escalations, and resolutions impacting employees or customers.


**Qualifications \& Experience**


**Required**


* 10\-15 \+ years of progressive payroll leadership experience, with significant exposure to multi\-country **APAC** payroll.
* Strong knowledge of **APAC** payroll regulations, taxation, and employment legislation.
* Proven experience managing Local Payroll Providers (LPPs) across multiple countries.
* Demonstrated success in process improvement, standardization, and operational optimization.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leadership.
* Experience leading teams in a complex, matrixed environment.
* Experience supporting payroll delivery in customer\-facing environments, including interaction with clients or internal customers regarding payroll outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience resolving complex payroll or employee pay issues requiring cross\-functional coordination and root cause analysis.


**Preferred**


* Experience in a multinational organization with regional or global payroll scope.
* Experience in payroll outsourcing and/or EOR.
* Exposure to payroll system implementations or integrations.
* Familiarity with Customer Support / Ticketing Systems such as Zendesk, HubSpot, Salesforce.
* Payroll certification (CPP, GPP, or equivalent).
* Experience supporting vendor consolidation and/or transformation initiatives.
* Experience operating within service delivery models with defined SLAs, customer performance metrics, or contractual service obligations.


**Key Competencies**


* Strategic thinker with strong operational execution capability
* Results\-driven, with a focus on accuracy and compliance
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Effective change leadership and stakeholder engagement
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to navigate complexity across multiple **APAC** jurisdictions
* Customer\-oriented mindset with strong ownership of service outcomes and employee experience
* Ability to drive accountability across distributed teams and third\-party providers

  



This position description may not describe all duties, responsibilities, and skills associated with this position. It is intended to portray the major aspects of the job. Other duties or skills may be required.

  


**What We Offer**


* The opportunity to work with a purpose — simplifying global expansion across borders and cultures
* A diverse and inclusive environment
* Country\-specific benefits
* Flexible PTO
* Your birthday off and a day for you to volunteer and give back to the organization of your choice

* Growth and development opportunities with access to a top learning content provider
* The opportunity to challenge yourself in a high\-performing organization and leave each day knowing you have made an impact.

Support off\-cycle payrolls, supplemental payments, and payroll corrections as needed. Validation, payroll execution, statutory compliance, reconciliations, and vendor coordination.

Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end payroll activities.

Research and resolve complex payroll issues while providing excellent customer service.


Educate employees and stakeholders on payroll processes, policies, and compliance requirements.

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.


5\+ years of payroll experience, including multi\-country APAC payroll processing.


Strong understanding of payroll regulations, taxation, and statutory requirements across APAC countries.


Experience working with outsourced payroll providers.

Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and reconciliation skills.

Experience supporting payrolls in countries such as India, Australia, Finland, New Zealand, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, and Hong Kong.


Experience in a multinational organization with global payroll operations.


Knowledge of payroll accounting and general ledger reconciliations.

description:
**Career Area:**


Human Resources**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


Role Definition


The Talent Acquisition Partner is responsible for leading the full recruitment lifecycle and serving as a strategic advisor to hiring managers. This role provides expertise in talent acquisition, including workforce planning, candidate sourcing, assessment, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding coordination. The incumbent partners closely with business leaders to develop and execute hiring strategies that support organizational objectives while ensuring an exceptional candidate experience.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to develop and execute recruitment strategies aligned with organizational goals and workforce plans.
* Provide market intelligence, talent insights, and data\-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions.
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessment coordination, reference checks, offer negotiation, and onboarding support.
* Utilize Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Candidate Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, and advanced sourcing tools to identify and engage top talent.
* Build and maintain robust talent pipelines to support current and future hiring needs.
* Implement sourcing strategies focused on attracting diverse and high\-quality talent while optimizing time\-to\-fill and cost\-per\-hire metrics.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience through proactive communication and effective stakeholder management.
* Monitor recruitment metrics and leverage workforce analytics to improve hiring outcomes and process efficiencies.
* Promote employer branding initiatives and represent the organization positively in the talent marketplace.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, employment legislation, and recruitment best practices.


Skill Descriptors

### **Relationship Management**

**Knowledge of relationship management techniques and the ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with business leaders, candidates, vendors, and peers.**

### **Level: Extensive Experience**

* Communicates effectively with stakeholders regarding recruitment expectations, timelines, and deliverables.
* Influences hiring managers and business leaders through data\-driven recommendations.
* Conducts regular reviews of recruitment progress, challenges, and successes.
* Builds and maintains long\-term partnerships with key stakeholders and external vendors.
* Creates opportunities to educate hiring teams on talent market trends and recruitment best practices.
* Mentors and empowers others to establish collaborative and productive working relationships.

### **Customer/Market Focus**

**Understanding of evolving market trends and the ability to respond to customer and business needs in a manner that consistently adds value.**

### **Level: Working Knowledge**

* Identifies expressed and unexpressed business talent needs.
* Aligns recruiting strategies to critical business objectives.
* Develops methods to improve responsiveness and service delivery.
* Balances candidate quality, speed, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Escalates issues that could impact stakeholder satisfaction or business outcomes.

### **Recruitment Channel Management**

**Knowledge of selecting, implementing, and managing recruitment channels to support talent acquisition objectives.**

### **Level: Working Knowledge**

* Utilizes multiple recruitment channels to attract top talent.
* Identifies and manages cost\-effective sourcing partners and recruitment vendors.
* Evaluates recruitment channel effectiveness through analytics and hiring outcomes.
* Adheres to organizational recruitment standards and processes.
* Recommends and supports recruitment channel optimization initiatives.

### **Candidate Screening**

**Knowledge of effective candidate assessment and screening methodologies.**

### **Level: Extensive Experience**

* Screens candidates for professional, technical, and leadership roles.
* Ensures compliance with HR policies and recruitment standards throughout the screening process.
* Oversees candidate tracking and information management within recruitment systems.
* Coaches colleagues and hiring managers on effective interviewing and evaluation techniques.
* Leverages industry best practices to enhance candidate assessment quality.

### **Candidate Sourcing**

**Knowledge of sourcing techniques, methods, and tools to attract top talent.**

### **Level: Extensive Experience**

* Develops and executes multi\-channel sourcing strategies.
* Advises business leaders on talent availability and sourcing approaches.
* Recommends enhancements to sourcing tools, technologies, and processes.
* Ensures compliance with sourcing policies and ethical recruiting practices.
* Conducts workforce and talent market research to support strategic hiring decisions.
* Benchmarks sourcing strategies against industry best practices.

### **Staffing and Recruiting**

**Knowledge of staffing strategies, recruiting processes, and talent acquisition best practices.**

### **Level: Extensive Experience**

* Manages complex recruitment assignments across multiple business functions.
* Consults with stakeholders on workforce planning, recruitment strategies, and talent availability.
* Facilitates the adoption of recruitment best practices and process improvements.
* Evaluates and improves recruitment systems, tools, and methodologies.
* Coaches and mentors recruiters and hiring managers on effective hiring practices.
* Monitors industry trends and competitive talent landscapes.

### **Workforce Analytics**

**Knowledge of HR metrics, workforce trends, and reporting methodologies that support informed business decisions.**

### **Level: Working Knowledge**

* Analyzes recruitment and workforce data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Generates reports and dashboards to support leadership decision\-making.
* Tracks key recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-fill, quality of hire, and source effectiveness.
* Utilizes workforce analytics tools to improve hiring outcomes.
* Identifies and escalates data quality or reporting issues.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **8\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, Executive Search, or Human Resources.**
* Proven experience managing end\-to\-end recruitment for technical, professional, and leadership hiring.

* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.

* Support audits related to HR systems and employee data.

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience supporting HRIS or HR technology platforms.
* Experience with Workday, Vndly or similar Human Capital Management (HCM) and Vendor Management Systems (VMS).
* Knowledge of HR business processes including recruiting, onboarding, core HR, payroll, benefits, and contingent workforce management.
* Experience supporting system integrations using APIs, EIBs, middleware, or other integration technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experience with reporting and analytics tools is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Ability to work pro\-actively, independently and multi\-task on multiple projects with multiple deadlines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting contingent workforce technologies such as VNDLY.
* Experience with HR system implementations or major enhancement projects.
* Knowledge of data governance, security administration, and compliance requirements.

* HR Technology Administration
* Data Integrity \& Governance
* Systems Integration
* Business Process Analysis
* Process Improvement
* Customer Service
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Attention to Detail

HighLevel is an AI\-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150\+ countries, fueling community\-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.  

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

**Our People**  

With over 2,000 team members across 10\+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote\-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

description:
**Function**

HR
**Our Company**
===============

We’re Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We’re crucial to the company’s strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast\-moving digital transformation market.  

  



Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full\-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real\-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.  

  



Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don’t expect you to ‘fit’ every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.


**Job description**
===================

**Position Summary**

The HR Technology Integrations Analyst is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and optimizing the organization's Workday integration ecosystem. This role ensures the reliable exchange of HR, payroll, benefits, finance, and third\-party application data through the design, monitoring, troubleshooting, and enhancement of Workday integrations.


The analyst serves as a key liaison between Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Information Technology, and external vendors to ensure seamless data flow, system reliability, and compliance with organizational standards. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical expertise in Workday integration technologies, data mapping, troubleshooting, testing, and process automation, along with a solid understanding of HR business processes.


**Key Responsibilities**

**HR Systems Administration**

* Support the day\-to\-day administration, monitoring, and maintenance of Workday integrations and related data interfaces.
* Manage and troubleshoot integration failures, errors, and data discrepancies to ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain integration schedules, configurations, documentation, and support procedures.
* Participate in Workday releases, updates, and feature deployments, including impact assessments and testing activities.
* Collaborate with Workday functional teams to support changes affecting integrations and downstream systems.
* Support the day\-to\-day administration and maintenance of HR technology platforms, such as Workday, VNDLY, and other integrated HR systems, which includes supporting business processes, security roles, and workflows in accordance with business requirements.
* Troubleshoot system issues, coordinate resolutions, and escalate technical problems when appropriate.
* Participate in system upgrades, testing, and new feature implementations.

**Data Management \& Reporting**

* Perform data audits, identify discrepancies, and implement corrective actions.
* Support data requests from HR, Payroll, Finance, and business leaders.

**Systems Integrations**

* Monitor and support integrations between HR systems and third\-party applications.
* Partner with IT and vendors to troubleshoot integration failures and resolve data transmission issues.
* Lead in implementing new integrations and enhancements to improve data flow and operational efficiency.
* Validate data mappings and facilitate end\-to\-end testing during implementation projects.

**Process Improvement**

* Analyze HR business processes and recommend technology solutions that improve efficiency, automation, and user experience.
* Document business requirements, process flows, and system configurations.
* Participate in cross\-functional projects involving HR technology implementations and enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes and reduce manual work.

**User Support \& Training**

* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer.

* 4\-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.

**Administering Employee Training Programs**


* Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.


* Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.


* Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.


* Ensures employees receive on\-going training to understand guest expectations.


* Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.


* Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.


* Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.

* Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.


* Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.


* Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.


* Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.


* Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.


* Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.

* Ensures all training and development activities (department specific and general property training) are strategically linked to the organization’s mission and vision.


* Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.


* Makes any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re\-trains as appropriate.


* Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.


* Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.


* Develops specific training to improve service performance.


* Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.


* Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.

  



**Managing Training Budgets**


* Participates in the development of the Training budget as required.


* Manages budget in alignment with Human Resources and property financial goals.


* Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.


* Utilizes P\-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

title: R&D Intern
description:
R\&D Intern

**Company:** THE CTC AGENCY  
**Department:** Research \& Development  
**Employment Type:** Internship  
**Work Mode:** Work From Home / Work From Office  
**Experience:** Freshers / Students / Entry\-Level Candidates

Role Overview

THE CTC AGENCY is looking for a curious and research\-oriented **R\&D Intern** to support the team in researching emerging technologies, tools, products, market trends, business ideas, and innovative solutions.

The intern will work on research, analysis, experimentation, documentation, and proof\-of\-concept activities across technology and business\-related projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct research on emerging technologies, software, platforms, tools, and digital solutions.
* Research new products, services, competitors, market trends, and industry developments.
* Identify potential technologies and solutions that can improve existing business processes.
* Collect, organize, and analyze information from reliable sources.
* Compare different technologies, platforms, tools, and solutions based on defined requirements.
* Assist in developing Proof of Concepts (PoCs), prototypes, and experimental solutions.
* Test new software, applications, APIs, platforms, and technology products.
* Support feasibility studies and technology evaluations.
* Conduct basic technical and functional experiments.
* Document research findings, observations, test results, and recommendations.
* Prepare research reports, comparison sheets, presentations, and internal documentation.
* Assist senior team members in innovation and product\-development initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and technology adoption.
* Monitor relevant technology and industry developments.
* Collaborate with technology, business, marketing, and operations teams when required.

Areas of Research

Depending on project requirements, the intern may work on:

* Artificial Intelligence \& Generative AI
* Web \& App Technologies
* SaaS Products
* Automation \& No\-Code/Low\-Code Platforms
* APIs \& Integrations
* Cloud Technologies
* Cybersecurity \& Data Protection
* Digital Marketing Technologies
* CRM \& HRMS Technologies
* FinTech \& Business Technology
* Emerging Software \& Platforms
* Market \& Competitor Research
* New Business/Product Ideas

Skills Required

* Strong research and analytical ability
* Logical and structured thinking
* Curiosity and willingness to explore new technologies
* Good internet research skills
* Basic understanding of technology and digital platforms
* Good written and verbal communication
* Data interpretation and comparison skills
* Documentation and report\-writing skills
* Presentation skills
* Problem\-solving ability
* Attention to detail
* Ability to learn independently

Technical Skills

Candidates with knowledge of any of the following will have an advantage:

* HTML, CSS, JavaScript or basic programming
* Python or any programming language
* APIs and JSON
* Databases
* AI tools and LLM technologies
* Cloud platforms
* Git/GitHub
* Automation tools
* WordPress/CMS
* Analytics and research tools
* Excel / Google Sheets
* PowerPoint / Google Slides

**Programming expertise is not mandatory** if the candidate demonstrates strong research, analytical, and learning capabilities.

Eligibility

* Students pursuing **Bachelor's or Master's degree** can apply.
* Graduates and postgraduates from **Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Management, Business, Commerce, Research, or related fields** may apply.
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with personal projects, research work, technical experiments, certifications, or portfolios will be preferred.

Work ModeWork From Home

Candidates working remotely must have:

* Personal laptop/desktop
* Reliable internet connection
* Smartphone
* Ability to attend online meetings
* Comfortable working independently and submitting research/documentation within deadlines

Work From Office

Candidates will work collaboratively with the R\&D and cross\-functional teams and may participate in brainstorming sessions, testing, workshops, and project discussions.

Performance Parameters

The intern may be evaluated on:

* Quality of research
* Accuracy and reliability of information
* Analytical ability
* Research depth
* Quality of reports and documentation
* Problem\-solving
* Experimentation and PoC execution
* Timely completion of assignments
* Initiative and curiosity
* Ability to present findings
* Contribution to innovation and process improvement

What You Will Learn

* Professional research methodologies
* Technology evaluation
* Market and competitor analysis
* Product research
* Proof\-of\-concept development
* Emerging technology assessment
* Business problem analysis
* Technical documentation
* Innovation and product development
* Cross\-functional project collaboration

Career Opportunity

High\-performing interns may be considered for full\-time opportunities based on performance, skills, organizational requirements, and available positions.

**Potential Career Path:**

**R\&D Intern → R\&D Associate → R\&D Executive / Analyst → Senior R\&D Executive / Analyst → R\&D Lead → R\&D Manager**

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who **doesn't just search for answers but enjoys discovering how things work, testing new ideas, comparing possibilities, and finding better ways to solve problems.**

If you are curious about **technology, business, innovation, AI, products, and emerging trends**, this role can provide hands\-on exposure to real\-world R\&D activities at THE CTC AGENCY.

Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

0 to 5 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
Candidates with 0–1 year of experience should demonstrate capability through academic projects, internships, certifications, GitHub repositories, hackathons, prototypes, or hands\-on GenAI experiments.
  
Candidates with 2–5 years of experience should have hands\-on experience building, integrating, testing, or deploying GenAI, AI assistant, chatbot, RAG, automation, or agentic workflow solutions.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.
  
  

**Equivalent qualifications may also be considered:**  

BCA / MCA / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or related disciplines from a recognized institution or university.
