description:
Company Description *At Konecranes, we believe that great customer experience is built on the people behind the Konecranes name. Everything we do, we do with passion and drive. We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to work.*

  

Job Description **Key Responsibilities:**

* Delivery punctuality 95%
* Production Planning \& Control (PPC)
* Material Requirement Planning (MRP)
* Capacity Planning
* Cross\-functional Coordination.
* ERP tool updating and maintenance.
* Maintenance of material master data.
* BOM and Cost Management

**Role and Responsibility:**

* Prepare and manage production plans and schedules to meet customer delivery commitments.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Production, Stores, Engineering, and Quality teams to ensure timely material availability and smooth production flow.
* Monitor production progress, identify bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions to achieve production targets.
* Perform material and capacity planning using ERP/MRP systems while maintaining optimal inventory levels.
* Analyze machine, manpower, and resource capacity.
* Monitor raw material, WIP (Work\-in\-Progress), and finished goods inventory
* Track production KPIs, prepare planning reports, and drive continuous process improvements to enhance productivity and on\-time delivery.
* Prioritize production according to delivery commitments.
* Monitor daily production progress against the plan.
* Maintain Bill of Materials (BOM) and production routing in the ERP system.
* Identify opportunities to improve planning accuracy and production efficiency.
* Support Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and 5S initiatives.
* Prepare daily and monthly production reports.
* Analyze production variances, bottlenecks, and resource utilization.
* Plan fabrication, machining, welding, painting, assembly, and testing activities.
* Coordinate long lead\-time items such as motors, gearboxes, wire ropes, electrical panels, and structural steel.
* Ensure compliance with project timelines for EOT cranes, gantry cranes, jib cranes, and customized lifting equipment.

  

Qualifications **Educatio**n Required: BE Mechanical / BE Electrical

**Professional Experience Required (Max – Min.)****:** 0 to 1 year (Freshers can apply)

**Competencies and Skills Required:**

* Awareness about ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 requirements.
* Compliance management.
* Communication skills.

**Mandatory Systems Knowledge and Tools Usability:**

* ERP systems and its working
* ISO

  

Additional Information **What we can offer you**:

* Competitive Salary
* Work\-Life balance
* Innovative and dynamic working environment
* Possibility to work in leading crane building company with leading technology.

  

***Konecranes moves what matters****. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000\+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.*

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
**Executive Assistant / Secretary**

WovV Technologies \| Vadodara

**About WovV Technologies**

WovV Technologies (WovVTech) is a global AI\-first SaaS and technology company headquartered in Dubai, building intelligent software platforms that help enterprises digitize operations, automate workflows, and make data\-driven decisions. Since our inception in 2016, we have been empowering businesses across **50\+ countries** with cutting\-edge AI\-powered products and enterprise technology solutions.

Our mission is simple: **Build technology that makes businesses more productive, efficient, and intelligent.**

Today, WovVTech's solutions are deployed across 3,000\+ locations worldwide, serving leading enterprises in Shopping Centres, Retail, Airports, Banking, Healthcare, Real Estate, Entertainment, Hospitality, Oil \& Gas, and other industries. We work with global enterprises to solve complex operational challenges using Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Analytics, Automation, and Open APIs.

**What We Build**

**Our portfolio of enterprise SaaS products includes:**

· **WovVRA** – AI\-powered Revenue Assurance \& Daily Sales Automation

· **WovVMaps** – Indoor Mapping, Navigation \& Location Intelligence

· **OKEN** – White\-labelled Customer Experience, Loyalty \& Engagement Platform

· **WovVLease** – Lease \& Commercial Management Platform

· **WovVBI** – Business Intelligence \& Executive Dashboards

· **WovVXM** – Experience Management (CX, NPS \& Feedback)

· **WovVIA** – Inspection \& Audit Platform

· **WovV360** – Tenant \& Enterprise Communication Platform

· **WovVVideo** – AI\-powered Video Analytics using CCTV

· Multiple AI agents and enterprise automation solutions built on our AI\-first technology platform.

**Why Join WovVTech?**

At WovVTech, you'll work on products that solve real\-world business problems at global scale. We combine the agility of a fast\-growing technology company with the opportunity to work on enterprise\-grade platforms used by some of the world's leading organizations.

**You'll have the opportunity to:**

· Build AI\-first enterprise products used globally

· Work with modern technologies including AI, Machine Learning, Cloud, Mobile, Analytics and Automation

· Collaborate with talented engineers, designers, product managers and business leaders

· Take ownership from idea to deployment

· Learn continuously through challenging projects across multiple industries

· Contribute to products that directly impact millions of consumers and thousands of businesses worldwide

**Our Culture**

We believe in ownership, innovation, customer obsession, continuous learning, and delivering excellence. Our teams are encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, challenge conventional approaches, and build products that create measurable business value.

We foster an environment where talented individuals can grow quickly, take responsibility, experiment with new ideas, and make a meaningful impact from day one.

**Global Presence**

· Headquarters: Dubai, UAE

· Global team across multiple countries

· Customers in 50\+ countries

· Hybrid, remote, and on\-site opportunities depending on the role.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an Executive Assistant / Secretary for our Mumbai location. This role supports the CEO with sophisticated calendar management, administrative coordination, and stakeholder communication. Freshers with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.

**What You'll Own**

1\. Provide sophisticated calendar management for the CEO.

2\. Work closely with the CEO to keep them well\-informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately.

3\. Assist in coordinating the agenda of senior management team meetings. Prepare an account of the meetings and designate and follow up on assigned action items.

4\. Provide a "gatekeeper" and "gateway" role, creating win\-win situations for direct access to the CEO's time and office.

5\. Executive Support \& Calendar Management

**Administrative Tasks \& Documentation**

1\. Complete a broad variety of administrative tasks that facilitate the CEO's ability to effectively lead the organisation, including: assisting with special projects; designing and producing complex documents, reports, and presentations; collecting and preparing information for meetings with staff and outside parties; composing and preparing correspondence; maintaining contact lists; making travel arrangements; and completing expense and mileage reports.

2\. Draft correspondence and other documentation to the CEO's specification.

3\. Work on project tracking and be open to taking up varied tasks.

**Stakeholder \& Financial Coordination**

1\. Maintain a high degree of confidentiality with regard to issues concerning members of staff and all stakeholders. Respond positively with tact, sensitivity, and awareness to all stakeholders in relation to duties undertaken.

2\. Coordinate with bankers for various queries and resolutions.

**What We're Looking For**

1\. Proven prior experience as Executive Assistant or similar role (freshers with relevant training are welcome).

2\. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

3\. Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and email communications.

4\. Thrives in an intense, do\-it\-yourself, start\-up environment.

5\. Ability to work well within a cross\-functional team environment and diverse communities.

6\. Ability to switch gears at a moment's notice.

7\. Exceptional organisational skills and impeccable attention to detail.

8\. Make appropriate, informed decisions regarding priorities and available time.

9\. Able to maintain a high level of integrity and discretion in handling confidential information.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 We are sydon. Commerce should be about the brand you build, not the operation you survive. Most operators run their business across fragmented tools that don't talk to each other, each one finding problems and handing the work back. We're building sydon Symphony, the agentic operating system for commerce, where AI agents do that work themselves and Symphony orchestrates them into one system instead of a fragmented stack of tools. Eleven of those agents run in production today.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 As a Data Engineer at Sydon.ai, you will design, build, and maintain data pipelines that power our AI\-driven platform for Commerce. In this full\-time remote role, you will develop and optimize ETL processes, integrate data from multiple sources, and ensure data quality, reliability, and scalability. You will collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to model data, support analytics, and enable new features. Daily responsibilities include managing data warehousing solutions, monitoring data infrastructure, troubleshooting performance issues, and implementing best practices for security and compliance. You will contribute to continuous improvement of our data architecture and help shape standards for data engineering across the organization. Deeply passionate about data, owning the data model, pipelines using data governance tools is a must.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong skills in Data Engineering and building scalable data pipelines.
* Candidates should possess solid Data Modeling skills to design well\-structured and efficient datasets.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes and Data Warehousing solutions.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in Data Analytics to support reporting, dashboards, and data\-driven decisions.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and modern data stack tools is beneficial.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (such as Python or Scala) is preferred.
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration and version control tools, and adherence to data security and privacy best practices are advantageous.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work effectively in a remote, cross\-functional team environment with clear communication and ownership of deliverables.



  





 Remote (India) · Full\-time, Flexible IST with a 6:30\-9:30 pm IST overlap window
 



  





 Start: immediate. If you are a fresher and hungry to learn, feel free to apply as well.

description:
**Overview About Ripik.AI**
 Ripik.ai is an Accel\-backed Applied AI company building computer vision and process optimization agents for the world's largest industrial enterprises across steel, cement, aluminum, chemicals, pharma, and power. Our Vision AI platform acts as an automated pair of eyes on the shop floor — monitoring materials, equipment, and processes 24/7 with 95%\+ accuracy, eliminating human error, and delivering measurable gains in throughput, yield, energy efficiency, and safety.
   

  

 We work with marquee customers including Tata Steel, JSW, ArcelorMittal, Vedanta, Godrej \& Boyce, Grasim, Holcim, and Jindal Steel, and are scaling globally across India, the Middle East,Europe, and North America. As we move into our next phase of growth, we are building the operating backbone that will take Ripik from a high\-velocity scale\-up to a category\-defining global industrial AI company.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a QA Engineer who takes ownership of quality across Ripik's industrial AI SaaS platform — from day\-to\-day manual testing of user flows to building and maintaining automated test suites. You will work across web, mobile, and desktop touchpoints, ensure APIs behave reliably under real\-world conditions, and bring an AI\-assisted, efficiency\-first mindset to how testing gets done.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own API automation testing — design, build, and maintain automated test suites for REST APIs, and integrate them into the release workflow.
* Run day\-to\-day manual testing of user flows — validate features end\-to\-end before every release, across web, mobile, and desktop.
* Write and maintain test cases, and own the testing charter — keeping test coverage, documentation, and test plans current as features evolve.
* Apply AI tools to the testing lifecycle — use AI to speed up test case generation, test data creation, and execution analysis for faster, more efficient coverage.
* Perform black\-box and exploratory manual testing — catching issues automated suites miss by thinking like a real user.
* Run regression testing ahead of releases — ensuring new changes don't break existing functionality across the platform.
* Test across browsers, multiple devices, and phones — verifying consistent behaviour across mobile apps, browser apps, and desktop apps.
* Support load testing efforts — helping validate that the platform holds up under real\-world usage volumes.


**Required Skills**

* Proven experience in both manual and automation testing, including hands\-on work with Selenium.
* Working knowledge of API automation testing.
* Strong foundation in manual testing — black\-box testing and user\-flow testing.
* Exposure to load testing and regression testing.
* Experience testing across browsers, multiple devices, and phones — ensuring consistency across mobile, browser, and desktop apps


**Good To Have**
* Familiarity with the frontend, backend, browser stack, and infra / cloud fundamentals.
* Business understanding — able to connect testing priorities to real user and business impact.

* World class work culture, coaching and development

title: Cloud Administrator
description:
**OpenShift Administrator (L1\) — Noida \| Onsite \| 24x7 Rotational Shifts \| 15 Positions** 




 We are hiring OpenShift Administrators for a large on\-premise private cloud estate at a client data centre in Noida. You will provide first\-line support for a production Red Hat OpenShift container platform running live workloads, within an ITIL\-aligned support model with defined SLAs.
 



**Please read before applying** 



* This is an
 **onsite** 
 role at a client location in Noida. It is not remote or hybrid.
* The role runs on
 **24x7 rotational shifts, including nights and weekends.** 
 Willingness to work rotational shifts is mandatory and will be confirmed at screening.
* You must be based in Delhi NCR or able to relocate.



**What you'll do** 



* Monitor cluster, node and pod health; acknowledge and act on alerts within defined SLA
* Handle incidents and service requests through the ticketing system — logging, categorisation, first\-level diagnosis, resolution and escalation
* Perform routine platform operations using the oc CLI and web console — pod restarts, deployment scaling, log retrieval, node status checks
* Troubleshoot common workload issues — pods in CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, Pending or Evicted states — and identify whether the cause sits with the application or the platform
* Manage projects and namespaces, apply resource quotas and limit ranges, and action basic RBAC requests under approved process
* Monitor persistent volume claims, storage capacity and certificate expiry; raise issues before they become incidents
* Support application teams with deployment queries, route configuration and access requests
* Execute documented runbooks; escalate to L2 with complete diagnostic detail when an issue falls outside L1 scope
* Maintain accurate shift handover notes and contribute to the knowledge base



**What you'll need** 



* 2–3 years hands\-on experience supporting OpenShift or Kubernetes in a production or pre\-production environment
* Working knowledge of core Kubernetes and OpenShift objects — pods, deployments, deployment configs, services, routes, config maps, secrets, persistent volume claims
* Comfortable with the oc and kubectl command line; able to read pod and container logs and describe output to isolate a problem
* Understanding of container fundamentals — images, registries, container runtime behaviour
* Solid Linux administration fundamentals on RHEL or CentOS
* Basic networking — DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, ingress and routing concepts
* Experience with a ticketing tool such as ServiceNow, Remedy or Jira Service Management
* Basic shell scripting
* B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, IT or a related discipline



**Nice to have** 



* Red Hat certification — RHCSA, or Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration
* Exposure to the OpenShift monitoring stack — Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager
* Exposure to CI/CD tooling — Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab CI, ArgoCD
* Familiarity with Helm
* Prior experience in a 24x7 or shift\-based support environment



**Other details** 



* Full\-time employment; resources are deployed onsite at the client location
* Notice period: 20–30 days preferred. Longer notice considered where a buyout is possible.

 **priyanka@truetechpro.io** 
 with CV, current location, notice period, and current and expected CTC.

description:
**Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert (AI Security)**
**About The Role**
 What if your hacking skills could directly shape how safe and secure AI systems are for millions of users worldwide? We're looking for Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Experts to probe, attack, and stress\-test AI\-powered applications and infrastructure — identifying vulnerabilities before bad actors do.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your offensive security expertise meets the cutting edge of artificial intelligence. You'll work on high\-impact projects that directly improve the security posture of AI systems used at scale.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Conduct penetration tests against AI\-powered applications, APIs, and infrastructure to uncover security vulnerabilities
* Identify and exploit weaknesses in AI/ML pipelines, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning vectors, and authentication flaws
* Perform web application, network, and API security assessments using industry\-standard tools and methodologies
* Simulate real\-world attack scenarios — from reconnaissance through exploitation and post\-exploitation
* Document findings in clear, structured reports with severity ratings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance
* Evaluate AI\-specific attack surfaces including adversarial inputs, jailbreaks, and data exfiltration risks
* Stay current with emerging AI security threats and contribute insights to improve testing methodologies
* Work independently on task\-based engagements on your own schedule


**Who You Are**
* Experienced penetration tester with a strong understanding of offensive security principles and methodologies (OWASP, PTES, MITRE ATT\&CK)
* Proficient with industry\-standard tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, or equivalent
* Solid understanding of web application security, network security, and API security testing
* Able to think like an attacker — creative, persistent, and methodical in finding what others miss
* Strong written communication skills — you can translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports
* Self\-motivated and reliable when working independently without direct supervision
* Comfortable working across diverse technology stacks and environments


**Nice to Have**
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CEH, GPEN, GXPN, or eWPT
* Experience with AI/ML security testing — adversarial machine learning, prompt injection, LLM red\-teaming
* Background in red teaming, bug bounty programs, or CTF competitions
* Familiarity with cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security
* Programming or scripting skills in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar
* Knowledge of secure development practices and DevSecOps workflows
* Experience conducting security assessments in compliance\-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.)


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI security projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with access to high\-impact, intellectually challenging engagements
* Be at the forefront of AI security — a rapidly growing field with massive demand
* Sharpen your skills against novel AI\-specific attack surfaces that few security professionals have encountered
* Contribute directly to making AI systems safer and more trustworthy for users worldwide
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.

* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.

**Education**:

Position Overview:  

The Ops Staff is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.  

The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.  

Job Purpose:  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.  

Key Roles \& Responsibilities:  

Shipment Processing \& Operations* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.

* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.

* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.

* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.

* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

  

Data Entry \& Operational Documentation* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.

* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.

* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.

* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.

description:

**Function:** Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) / Assurance / Audit

**Reports to:** Audit Manager / Lead Auditor / GRC Program Lead

**Role Summary :**

As a **GRC Audit Intern**, you will support audit teams in planning, evidence collection, testing, and reporting for management system and assurance engagements, including **ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS), ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS), ISO/IEC 27701 (PIMS), SOC 2**, and compliance assessments aligned to **HIPAA, GDPR, and India’s DPDP Act**. This is a hands\-on, onsite internship designed to build practical skills in audit execution, controls testing, and compliance documentation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Audit Support \& Execution**

* Assist auditors during **onsite** audits: meeting notes, evidence walkthroughs, and coordination with client stakeholders.
* Support **audit planning** activities: scope understanding, sampling lists, and evidence requests.
* Perform **controls testing support** under supervision (design/implementation checks) for security, privacy, and AI governance controls.

**Evidence Collection \& Documentation**

* Collect and organize evidence (policies, SOPs, logs, tickets, screenshots, configurations, training records).
* Maintain evidence trackers and ensure proper naming, versioning, and traceability.
* Help map evidence to standard/framework requirements (clauses, controls, Trust Services Criteria, regulatory requirements).

**Gap Assessment \& Reporting**

* Support identification of gaps, observations, OFIs, and nonconformities with clear references.
* Draft sections of audit deliverables: checklists, working papers, meeting minutes, and summary notes.
* Assist with corrective action follow\-ups: tracking CAPA status and closure evidence.

**Tools \& Coordination**

* Update audit trackers, risk registers, SoA/controls mapping sheets, and project documentation repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams for scheduling, logistics, and documentation completeness.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow internal information security policies at all times.

**Standards / Framework Exposure (During Internship)**

You may work across one or more of the following (based on project allocation):

* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022** – Information Security Management Systems
* **ISO/IEC 42001:2023** – AI Management Systems (AIMS)
* **ISO/IEC 27701:2019** – Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)
* **SOC 2** – Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy)
* **HIPAA** – Security/Privacy Rule alignment (as applicable)
* **GDPR** – Privacy compliance assessment support
* **DPDP Act (India)** – Data protection compliance support

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in **Information Security, Computer Science, IT, Risk/Compliance, Cybersecurity, Law/Policy (tech)** or related fields.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity audit concepts and frameworks.

**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Familiarity with any of: ISO 27001 controls, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP, risk assessment, privacy principles.
* Interest in AI governance/AI risk and model lifecycle basics (helpful for ISO 42001 projects).

**Internship Outcomes / Learning**

* Understanding how certification/assurance audits are conducted and how evidence is evaluated.
* Improved professional writing: working papers, checklists, summaries, and CAPA tracking.
* Exposure to multi\-framework compliance expectations across security, privacy, and AI governance.

**Professional Expectations**

* Maintain strict confidentiality and follow security policies.
* Be punctual and dependable for onsite schedules and client meetings.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
* Conduct yourself professionally with clients and internal teams.

**Potential Full\-Time Conversion (Post Internship):**

Subject to **Performance**, selected interns may be considered for **Conversion to a Full\-time Position** at the end of the 6\-month internship.

title: IoT / Embedded Systems Enginee
description:
**Company Description** 
 :
 



 SnifferBots is a Pune\-based IoT hardware company on a mission to stop electrical fires before they start.
 



  
 



 Electrical control panels and switchgear are protected against overcurrent, overvoltage, and short\-circuits — but not against the slow build\-up of heat, humidity, and gas that actually causes most panel fires. SnifferBots closes that gap. Our sensing units install inside each feeder compartment, continuously monitor conditions in real time, and can proactively trip a feeder before a fault becomes a fire, with live alerts on a connected app.
 



  
 



 We're a small, hands\-on team building hardware that gets deployed inside real electrical infrastructure, and we're now developing our next\-generation device. If you want to build safety\-critical technology that protects people, equipment, and uptime, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 SnifferBots builds IoT hardware that detects the early warning signs of electrical fires — abnormal heat, humidity, and gas — inside control panels and switchgear, and can proactively trip a feeder before a fault becomes a fire. We're building our next\-generation device and looking for a hands\-on engineer to help take it from prototype to product.
 



  
 



 What you'll do:
 



 • Build and iterate on hardware prototypes (ESP32\-based) integrating temperature, humidity, and gas sensors
 



 • Write and maintain firmware in C/C\+\+ (Arduino framework): sensor logic, alarm thresholds, relay control, OTA updates, offline data buffering
 



 • Integrate the device with a cloud database (Firebase) for real\-time and historical data logging
 



 • Build automated SMS (MSG91\) and email alerts for warning/critical conditions
 



 • Debug across the full stack — sensors, firmware, and cloud connectivity

title: WiFi SW Engineer (Staff)
description:
**Role Overview**
 NETGEAR is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Embedded Software team building next\-generation home gateway platforms. This role centers on Qualcomm networking SoCs and the prplOS/prplMesh open\-source stack, contributing across system services, network stacks, WiFi mesh features, and the App and Web GUI configuration interfaces that power our connected home products.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of low\-level embedded systems and modern mesh networking, partnering closely with hardware teams to validate radio performance and deliver reliable, high\-performance WiFi experiences to millions of NETGEAR customers worldwide.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and integrate prplMesh components across Qualcomm, Broadcom, and MediaTek\-based SoCs.
* Apply AI\-centric design practices to WiFi software development (Prompt → Context → Harness engineering).
* Partner with the hardware team to validate radio performance and mesh stability.
* Interface with mesh APIs, WiFi drivers, and the 1905\.1 protocol stack.
* Implement configuration and telemetry reporting through the App and Web GUI.
* Provide technical leadership across the networking stack, mesh stack, and control panel development.
* Conduct functional and performance testing, drive bug fixes, and support customer escalations.
* Contribute to 802\.11, Bluetooth, Thread, or Matter platform development as applicable.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in embedded Linux development (C/C\+\+, Shell, Python, Lua).
* Familiarity with Qualcomm, Broadcom, and MediaTek QSDK, OpenWrt, or Yocto\-based systems.
* Solid understanding of wireless networking, 802\.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be, mesh networking, and QoS.
* Strong understanding of Linux kernel and user\-space interactions.
* Working knowledge of bridging, Ethernet, VLAN, TCP/UDP, IPv4/IPv6, DHCP, NAT, DNS, and routing protocols.
* Familiarity with firewalling, iptables/nftables, and traffic shaping.
* Working knowledge of network functions for router or gateway products.
* Experience with 802\.11 platforms and prplOS/prplMesh architecture and development.
* Experience profiling WiFi performance including RSSI/SNR metrics, DFS, AWGN, and channel steering.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to quality.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with EasyMesh or vendor\-specific mesh platforms.
* Working knowledge of Web and App interface integration and development.


**Company Statement/Values**
 At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.
   

  

 We're a performance\-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world\-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the
 *Next Gear* 
 by living our values: we
 **Dare to Transform** 
 the future,
 **Connect and Delight** 
 our customers,
 **Communicate Courageously** 
 with each other and collaborate to
 **Win It Together** 
 . You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.
   

  

 We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward\-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.
   

  

*NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

title: Order Processing Assistant
description:
We are looking for an **Order Processing Assistant** to support the team in day\-to\-day order processing, documentation, invoice uploading, delivery tracking and order closure activities.

The candidate will work **under the supervision of the Admin Manager** and will be responsible for timely follow\-up, accurate documentation and coordination with internal departments.

Key ResponsibilitiesOrder Processing \& Execution

* Receive and process customer **Purchase Orders / Work Orders**.
* Check basic PO details such as product, quantity, rate, GST, delivery terms and other requirements.
* Update order details in Excel/system and maintain the **Order Execution Tracker**.
* Coordinate internally with **Sales, Accounts, Billing, Stores, Logistics and Service** teams for order execution.
* Track orders from **PO receipt to final completion**.
* Follow up on dispatch, delivery, installation and commissioning activities.
* Maintain delivery challans, installation reports, commissioning reports and other completion documents.
* Ensure timely follow\-up of pending order\-related activities.

Invoice \& Portal Activities

* Coordinate with the Billing team for invoice preparation.
* Verify invoice details against the relevant PO/WO.
* **Upload invoices on GeM and other applicable customer portals.**
* Upload required supporting documents along with invoices.
* Maintain records of invoice submissions and acknowledgements.
* Track invoice status and follow up on pending or rejected invoices.
* Coordinate internally for corrections and re\-submission wherever required.

Documentation \& Record Management

* Maintain proper soft and hard copies of order\-related documents.
* Maintain and regularly update order execution trackers.
* Ensure all documents are properly filed and easily retrievable.
* Maintain records of PO, delivery, installation, commissioning, invoice and order closure documents.

Coordination \& Follow\-up

* Coordinate with internal departments for timely completion of assigned activities.
* Follow up regularly on pending deliveries, installations, invoices and documentation.
* Keep the **Admin Manager** updated regarding pending activities, delays or issues.
* Assist in preparing daily, weekly and monthly operational reports.
* Perform other operational tasks assigned by the reporting manager.

Skills Required

* Basic knowledge of **Tally**, **MS Excel, MS Word and Email**.
* Good communication and follow\-up skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good documentation and data\-entry skills.
* Good coordination and organizational skills.
* Basic computer and internet skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.

Eligibility

* Graduate in any discipline.
* **Freshers are welcome to apply.**
* 0–2 years of experience in order processing, back\-office, operations or sales coordination will be an advantage.
* Experience with **GeM/customer portal invoice uploading** will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be **organized, responsible, detail\-oriented and good at follow\-up**. The candidate should be comfortable working with **Excel, emails, online portals and documentation** and should have a willingness to learn business operations and order execution processes.

**Salary:** ₹16,000\-20,000 per month, depending on candidate's experience, skills and current salary.

description:
**Field Sales Executive – Dealer Development \& Secondary Sales (Neycer Sanitaryware)**

**Location**

Kanchipuram (Tamil Nadu)

Reporting To

Sales Manager – Neycer Sanitaryware

About Neycer

Neycer is one of India's established sanitaryware brands, offering a wide range of sanitaryware and bathroom solutions. We are looking for energetic and result\-oriented field sales professionals to expand our dealer network, increase market penetration, and drive secondary sales across assigned territories.

Job Summary

The Field Sales Executive will be responsible for regularly visiting dealers, retailers, plumbers, builders, contractors, and influencers in the assigned territory to generate sales for Neycer products.

The role requires identifying and onboarding new dealers, supporting existing dealers in improving sales, generating enquiries, and ensuring consistent secondary sales growth.

This is a performance\-driven role with a fixed salary and attractive incentives linked directly to business generated.

Key Responsibilities

**Market Visits \& Relationship Building**

· Conduct daily market visits within the assigned territory.

· Meet sanitaryware dealers, retailers, distributors, plumbers, builders, contractors, and architects.

· Promote Neycer sanitaryware products and create brand awareness.

· Build and maintain strong relationships with channel partners.

Dealer \& Retailer Onboarding

· Identify potential dealers and retailers for Neycer products.

· Explain dealership opportunities and product advantages.

· Assist in dealer onboarding and activation.

· Expand Neycer's market presence in assigned locations.

Secondary Sales Generation

· Generate orders through existing dealers and retailers.

· Increase product movement from dealer counters.

· Follow up on enquiries and convert them into sales.

· Support dealers in achieving higher monthly sales volumes.

· Monitor stock availability and coordinate replenishment requirements.

Influencer Engagement

· Develop relationships with plumbers, contractors, architects, and builders.

· Generate project leads and referral business.

· Promote Neycer products for residential and commercial projects.

Market Intelligence

· Gather information on competitor activities, pricing, schemes, and product launches.

· Identify opportunities for market expansion and business growth.

· Provide regular feedback on customer requirements and market trends.

Reporting

· Submit daily and weekly market visit reports.

· Maintain records of dealer visits, enquiries, orders, and business generated.

· Track dealer performance and sales achievements.

Eligibility Criteria Education

· Any Graduate / Diploma Holder.

· Candidates with experience in sanitaryware, tiles, building materials, hardware, plumbing products, paints, electricals, or FMCG sales preferred.

Experience

· Freshers with strong field sales aptitude can apply.

· 1–5 years of field sales experience preferred.

Skills Required

· Strong communication and persuasion skills.

· Ability to build dealer relationships.

· Self\-motivated and target\-oriented.

· Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

· Basic reporting and smartphone usage skills.

**Compensation Structure Fixed Salary**

**₹10,000 per month Performance Incentives based on performance**

**Additional incentives will be paid based on:**

· Value of sales generated.

· Number of active dealers onboarded.

· Secondary sales achieved through dealers.

· New customer acquisitions.

· Project enquiries converted into business.

Earnings Potential

**No upper limit on incentives.**

High\-performing candidates can significantly increase their monthly earnings through successful dealer development and sales generation activities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

· Daily market visits completed.

· Number of dealers/retailers onboarded.

· Monthly sales generated.

· Secondary sales growth.

· Active dealer engagement.

· New project leads generated.

· Collection of market intelligence.

Preferred Candidate

**We are looking for individuals who:**

· Enjoy meeting customers and travelling in the market.

· Have a passion for sales and business development.

· Can independently generate enquiries and close business.

· Are eager to grow with a leading sanitaryware brand.

**Join Neycer and become a key contributor in expanding one of India's trusted sanitaryware brands across South India.**

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund

title: Marketing Engineer
description:
We are looking for a **Marketing Executive** to support our business development and marketing activities in the **STP, WTP, ETP, RO and wastewater treatment** sector.

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a willingness to learn technical products, and an interest in **B2B sales and business development**. The role will involve identifying new business opportunities, meeting clients and consultants, following up on enquiries, and supporting the sales team in generating new projects.

Key Responsibilities :

**1\. Business Development**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities for **STP, WTP, ETP, RO and related water\-treatment solutions**.
* Identify potential customers through market research, online platforms, industry databases, references, meeting consultants, architects and networking.
* Generate leads and maintain a systematic database of prospective clients.
* Make regular follow\-up calls, emails and client visits.
* Develop relationships with builders, developers, architects, consultants, MEP consultants, facility management companies, industries and institutions.

**2\. Client \& Consultant Interaction**

* Visit clients, consultants, project sites and offices as required.
* Understand the client's basic requirements and coordinate with the technical team for suitable solutions.
* Introduce the company's products, technologies and capabilities to prospective customers.
* Maintain regular communication with existing and potential clients.
* Participate in meetings, presentations and technical discussions with support from the technical team.

**3\. Enquiry \& Tender Support**

* Track incoming enquiries and coordinate with the estimation/technical team for quotations.
* Follow up on submitted quotations and commercial proposals.
* Assist in collecting project information such as capacity, technology requirement, specifications, BOQ and project timelines.
* Monitor tenders and upcoming projects relevant to the company's business.
* Maintain records of enquiries, quotations, follow\-ups and order status.

**4\. Marketing Activities**

* Support digital and offline marketing activities.
* Assist in preparing company presentations, product profiles, brochures and marketing material.
* Support participation in exhibitions, conferences, seminars and industry events.
* Coordinate with the management for LinkedIn, email marketing and other B2B marketing initiatives.

**5\. Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with the **Sales, Design, Estimation, Projects and O\&M teams**.
* Ensure that customer requirements are properly communicated internally.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, enquiries, meetings and follow\-ups.
* Provide regular updates to the reporting manager on business development activities.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.E./B.Tech – preferably Civil, Mechanical, Environmental, Chemical or related engineering disciplines
* B.Sc./M.Sc. – preferably Environmental Science, Chemistry or related fields
* MBA – preferably Marketing / Sales / Business Development
* Other relevant technical or management qualifications may also be considered

**Experience:**

* Freshers are welcome
* 1–2 years of experience in B2B sales, marketing, business development, infrastructure, construction, MEP, environmental services or water\-treatment industry will be an advantage

**Preferred**

* Basic understanding of **STP, WTP, ETP, RO, MBR, MBBR, SBR or wastewater treatment**
* Previous experience in technical sales or B2B sales
* Experience dealing with consultants, contractors, builders or industrial clients
* Knowledge of lead generation through LinkedIn, email and other digital platforms
* Valid driving licence and willingness to travel
* Willing to travel within Bangalore and occasionally outside Bangalore

title: Product Associate
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Product Associate will independently own and manage assigned product features and workflows for Duruper.com. This role is ideal for a hands\-on product professional who can translate business needs into clear, actionable product specifications and work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality outcomes. The position offers strong growth potential toward a full Product Manager role.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  




* Own and manage assigned product features or functional areas end\-to\-end
* Analyze business problems and convert them into clear product requirements
* Create, maintain, and update Product Requirement Documents (PRDs)
* Define detailed user flows, edge cases, and acceptance criteria
* Write user stories, tasks, and subtasks with clear definitions of done
* Manage and track work items using Jira
* Maintain structured product documentation in Notion (PRDs, specs, decisions)
* Collaborate with engineering, design, QA, and business stakeholders
* Coordinate requirement discussions and clarifications during development
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validate delivered features
* Capture user feedback and operational inputs to propose product improvements



  





**Mandatory Requirements** 




  




* 1–3 years of experience in Product Management, Associate Product, or Business Analyst roles
* Proven experience in writing PRDs, user stories, and functional specifications
* Hands\-on experience with Jira for task and issue tracking
* Strong documentation skills using Notion or Confluence
* Solid understanding of Agile product development methodologies
* Ability to work independently on defined problem statements
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and structured thinking approach

description:
**IT Scrum Master – Data \& AI Solutions CoE**
**PURPOSE AND SCOPE**
 The IT Scrum Master in the Data \& AI Solutions CoE provides delivery leadership and Agile coaching to one or more data, analytics, and AI\-focused technology teams. This role enables the successful execution of data\-driven initiatives that support the organization’s business strategy and digital transformation objectives.
   

  

 The Scrum Master ensures teams adhere to Agile and Scrum practices while delivering high\-quality data and AI products, including analytics platforms, machine learning models, and data pipelines. The role is responsible for maintaining predictable delivery, managing dependencies, and ensuring alignment to scope, timelines, and quality expectations within data and AI programs.
   

  

 The Scrum Master monitors team progress, promotes transparency across data initiatives, facilitates risk management, and ensures effective communication and escalation within the Data \& AI CoE and broader stakeholder community.
   

  

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
* Serve as Scrum Master for Data \& AI Agile teams, providing leadership, facilitation, and coaching to ensure successful delivery of data products and AI solutions.
* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, tailored to data and analytics workflows.
* Coach teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement within a data\-driven and AI\-centric environment.
* Partner with Product Owners, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers to support backlog prioritization, refinement, and clarity of user stories, including data requirements, model objectives, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify, track, and proactively remove impediments related to data dependencies, data quality issues, infrastructure constraints, and model lifecycle challenges.
* Promote transparency by tracking and communicating Agile metrics such as velocity, model delivery cycles, data pipeline readiness, and sprint progress.
* Support Agile planning and execution while ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance, AI standards, and delivery frameworks.
* Establish and maintain effective communication plans, ensuring timely updates to stakeholders on data initiatives, analytics outcomes, and AI model progress.
* Facilitate cross\-team collaboration across data engineering, data science, analytics, and platform teams to manage dependencies and shared risks.
* Contribute to the development and adoption of Agile best practices specifically tailored for Data \& AI delivery within the CoE.
* Apply sound judgment to resolve complex delivery challenges involving data integration, model development, and analytical workflows.
* Mentor and support less\-experienced Scrum Masters or team members within the Data \& AI CoE.
* Escalate risks, impediments, or delivery concerns related to data availability, model performance, or platform constraints to leadership when necessary.
* Ensure compliance with the Code of Business Conduct, data governance policies, AI ethics guidelines, and all applicable company procedures and regulations.
* Assist with additional Data \& AI initiatives and CoE\-related duties as assigned.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree required; Advanced Degree (Data Science, Analytics, AI, or related field) will be an added advantage .
* 5–8 years of related IT experience, including hands\-on experience supporting Agile teams in data, analytics, or AI/ML environments.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent Agile certification required or strongly preferred.
* Proven knowledge of Agile frameworks, Scrum practices, and SDLC methodologies, with exposure to DataOps, MLOps, or Analytics delivery models preferred.
* Experience working within a Data \& AI Center of Excellence, analytics practice, or enterprise data platform environment.
* Familiarity with data engineering concepts, machine learning lifecycle, analytics platforms, and cloud data ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Strong organizational and facilitation skills with the ability to manage multiple data initiatives and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work creatively, analytically, and independently in a fast\-paced, data\-driven problem\-solving environment.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across data engineers, data scientists, business stakeholders, and leadership teams.
* Effective conflict resolution and problem\-solving capabilities, especially in complex data environments.
* Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills.
* Ability to drive Agile maturity and sustain change within Data \& AI transformation initiatives.
* Strong business acumen; understanding of how data and AI drive business value is preferred.
* Experience in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, financial services) and familiarity with data compliance standards is a plus.

title: Firmware Engineer
description:
**Join SL Corporation India, Bengaluru as a Firmware Engineer.** 




  





**Job Summary** 




  





 The System Engineer – Embedded Firmware (Automotive IBS) is responsible for the design, development, testing, and maintenance of embedded firmware for 12V Intelligent Battery Sensor (IBS) applications. The role focuses on battery monitoring, state estimation (SOC/SOH), low\-level driver development, automotive communication protocols, and firmware validation while ensuring compliance with automotive quality and performance standards.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  




* Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware for 12V Intelligent Battery Sensor (IBS) systems.
* Develop algorithms for State of Charge (SOC), State of Health (SOH), and battery diagnostics.
* Develop low\-level drivers and integrate MCU peripherals such as UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, PWM, Flash, and EEPROM.
* Implement firmware using Embedded C and RTOS\-based architectures.
* Integrate firmware with automotive communication protocols including CAN and LIN.
* Perform firmware debugging, validation, and root cause analysis using Oscilloscopes, CAN Analyzers, JTAG, and Logic Analyzers.
* Support firmware integration, testing, and system validation activities.
* Analyze lead\-acid battery behavior, charging/discharging characteristics, battery aging, and temperature effects.
* Ensure compliance with coding standards and perform static code analysis.
* Collaborate with hardware, system, validation, and testing teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Maintain technical documentation and support continuous product improvements.



  





**Mandatory Requirements** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 2–4 years of experience in Embedded Firmware Development.
* Experience in Automotive Intelligent Battery Sensor (IBS) or Battery Monitoring Systems is preferred.
* Strong programming skills in Embedded C.
* Experience with RTOS.
* Hands\-on experience in MCU peripheral development (UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, PWM, Flash, EEPROM).
* Experience with automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN).
* Experience with firmware debugging and validation tools.
* Familiarity with automotive microcontrollers such as NXP, Renesas, Infineon, or Analog Devices.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

title: Recruiter
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

As a Recruiter, you will be the strategic engine behind our engineering growth. This isn't just about managing a funnel; it’s about acting as a talent advisor to our Engineering leadership, helping them navigate a competitive landscape to find the builders of our future. You’ll own the full lifecycle—from deep\-dive calibration sessions with Hiring Managers to crafting high\-touch candidate experiences that reflect our culture of innovation. Whether you are hunting for niche Backend experts or scaling our Frontend teams, you’ll use your deep understanding of the tech stack and the talent market to close the best in the business. If you are passionate about the "art of the close" and thrive in a data\-informed, high\-growth environment, we want you on our team  

  



This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the TA Manager, India.  

  



**Responsibility**


* Drive process improvements to help make the hiring process more effective, efficient and positive for both hiring managers and candidates
* Own the full candidate lifecycle for a variety of roles
* Source candidates from relevant networks, online and internal databases, employee referrals and passive candidates through networking and research
* Cultivate strong partnerships with hiring managers and key collaborators, providing strategic guidance on talent acquisition and workforce planning
* Collaborate with the wider HR team to enhance recruitment processes, ensuring efficiency, consistency, and a positive candidate experience
* Utilise market insights to tailor recruitment strategies, ensuring our approach remains competitive and aligned with the evolving needs of our organisation
* Track and report on key recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-fill, pass through rates \& offer acceptance rates

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

**Basic**

* 4\+ years of full\-lifecycle recruiting experience, with at least 3 years dedicated specifically to core technical roles (e.g., Backend, Frontend, Mobile, DevOps, or Data Engineering)
* Experience in partnering with Engineering leadership to define technical candidate personas, calibrate search parameters, and drive strategic alignment throughout the hiring lifecycle
* Hands\-on experience with Enterprise Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g.,Smart recruiters Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, or Workday)
* Proven track record of sourcing passive technical talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Stack Overflow, and X\-ray search string
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

**Preferred**


* Experience recruiting for high\-growth product companies or top\-tier tech firms
* Ability to use recruiting metrics (e.g., pass\-through rates, time\-to\-fill, and source\-of\-hire) to influence hiring decisions and forecast pipeline needs
* Proven ability to enhance the recruitment lifecycle by optimizing interview loops, elevating the candidate experience, and implementing scalable process improvements to drive hiring efficiency
* Expertise in local and global tech talent markets, with a proven ability to translate market intelligence, salary benchmarks, and competitor mapping into actionable hiring strategies

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  

  

  

**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.  

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.  

**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.  

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

title: Talent Acquisition Executive (Entry-Level)
description:
**Own the hiring engine that gets Biotastic's best people in the door — fast, right, every time.**

Biotastic builds and sells premium wellness equipment — ice baths, cold plunges, saunas, red light therapy and HBOT — trusted by JW Marriott, Shangri\-La, FC Goa and 200\+ HNI homes. As we scale across every department, every open role deserves a fast, sharp hiring process, not a bottleneck.

We're looking for the person who runs that process end to end — sourcing candidates, screening every CV against a real bar, and handing hiring managers a ranked shortlist they can trust — so the right person gets hired before a competitor gets to them first.

**What you'll own**

* Build and continuously refill a pool of **40–50 qualified candidates a week** across Naukri, LinkedIn, referrals and other channels — for every open Biotastic role
* Draft and post job adverts (not generic JDs) from an approved Role Scorecard, live within 48 hours of sign\-off
* Screen every CV against a structured, weighted rubric; deliver a ranked, branded shortlist to the hiring manager within **2 days** of closing the pool
* Schedule interviews within 24–48 hours of shortlist approval and keep every candidate's status current in the pipeline tracker — nothing goes stale
* Publish a weekly funnel report — pool size, drop\-off by stage, time\-to\-fill — and flag the weakest link before being asked
* Run knockout filters honestly and reject fast and kind, so no candidate is left hanging on a "maybe"
* Direct and quality\-check the work of any HR interns assigned to you — delegate sourcing and screening tasks and make sure their output meets the same bar as yours before it reaches a hiring manager

**You're a fit if you have**

* Some exposure to recruiting, sourcing or HR coordination — an internship, a prior TA role, or campus placement\-cell experience counts (under 2 years total experience)
* Strong written English — your adverts and candidate messages represent the Biotastic brand
* Comfort with Excel/Google Sheets and job portals like Naukri, Indeed, Apna and LinkedIn from day one
* High organization — you can run 3–5 hiring pipelines at once without dropping a candidate
* Genuine fluency with AI tools to speed up sourcing, screening and drafting
* Comfortable directing, delegating to and quality\-checking the work of HR interns — even if you've never formally "managed" anyone before.

**Bonus**

* Hands\-on with an ATS or a structured candidate tracker, not just email and Excel
* Experience sourcing across more than one function or department
* LinkedIn Recruiter or Boolean search experience
* Exposure to structured interviewing or scorecard\-based screening
* A background in HR, psychology or business with a real interest in People work
* Prior experience mentoring, training or team\-leading juniors/interns

**You'll thrive** here if you treat every requisition like it's urgent, take pride in handing over a shortlist no one has to second\-guess, and want real ownership this early in your career. You'll struggle here if you need heavy supervision, let CVs sit unscreened, or think recruiting is just forwarding resumes.

What we offer

* **CTC:** ₹2\.5–4 LPA fixed (based on experience)
* Real ownership of requisitions from day one — not admin, not just coordination
* **Growth path:** Talent Acquisition Executive → Senior Talent Acquisition Executive → Talent Acquisition Lead. Promotion is earned, not timed — hit your numbers consistently (pool, shortlist turnaround, intern quality) for about a year and take on more ownership as Biotastic's hiring volume grows

**How to apply**

Apply with your CV and answer these three questions in your application — **applications that skip any of them won't be reviewed:**

* Tell us about a time you sourced or shortlisted candidates, even informally — what did you do, and what happened?
* You have 5 open roles to source for this week, and only enough time for 3\. How do you decide where to spend your time?
* Name one AI tool you already use to speed up your own work, and how you use it.

Pay: ₹250,000\.00 \- ₹400,000\.00 per year

description:
Overview:

At PepsiCo, we’re redefining what it means to be a consumer products company with a digital\-first mindset, and our ServiceNow Platform C4E team is leading that charge. C4E is a cultural model, as it brings a “service mindset” to the organization’s work. It focuses on designing and delivering services that generate measurable value and provide a consumer\-grade experience to the business and the end users.


By definition, C4E applies to all functions and domains providing services (e.g. IT). But it’s logically hosted in the “Centre 4 Enablement” organization. Our technology teams unlock digital capabilities, enhance cybersecurity safeguards, deliver data\-driven insights, and create unmatched consumer and customer experiences.  

  

Our culture is guided by the PepsiCo Way, a set of values that define our mission to win with purpose in the marketplace and act with integrity in everything we do. We’re creating smiles with every sip and every bite while advancing a sustainable, socially impactful agenda that promotes our goal of Winning with Purpose.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**


You’ll be part of a tight\-knit team in a growing Global Business Solutions area. It’s a high\-profile role in which you’ll have plenty of opportunities to showcase your ability to not only lead a team but establish and maintain new customer relationships. As you do, you’ll be expected to showcase your technical, analytical, and consultancy skills – along with relationships that could define your career in a Product centric organization. We’ll support you in developing deep subject matter expertise so you can deliver on and exceed client expectations.

**JOB PURPOSE**


Reporting to the Lead Architect, the ServiceNow Solution Architect will be a technical consultant working to develop, design, and own technical solutions on the ServiceNow platform. You will provide administration, application development, maintenance, and technical support by using good practice web programming techniques to configure robust solutions to the client utilizing the ServiceNow platform.


Platform customization governance, in coordination with business stakeholders and the technology platform team to define and own the business roadmap of the platform, aligned to and consistent development practice with the ServiceNow technology capabilities roadmap.

* Participation in requirement gathering phases to provide time estimation to users’ needs.
* To lead, design, and implement overall solution architecture comprising the conceptual, technical, and physical aspects and code review
* Responsible for review of plan, design, and implementation of the overall solution architecture comprising conceptual (functional and non\-functional), technical and physical architecture
* Demonstrate Thought Leadership toward white space solutions
* Provide system \& application\-level solutions framework \& methodologies
* Understand the customer requirements to build/identify areas that need to be POCed (Proof Of Concept)
* Actively participate in POCs and present to the customer
* Conduct research on service offerings, market trends, industry analyst interactions
* Provide architectural oversight and guidance for RFPs and ongoing project deliveries
* Expert with Javascript and ServiceNow Javascript API's
* Write/create custom business rules, client scripts; the script includes UI policies, ACLs, data policies, UI scripts
* Lead development effort of solutions in three (3\) or more of the following specializations:
* ServiceNow Mainline Application(s) (ITSM, ITBM, CSM, HR, ITOM, etc)
* Service Portal (HTML, CSS, AngularJS, SASS, Bootstrap)
* Custom Application Development (Scoped Applications)
* 3rd Party Integrations Development (REST, SOAP, MID Servers, etc)
* Attend requirements review and validation sessions as required
* Participate in scrum ceremonies
* Deliver measurable, positive results within the client and team’s timeline resulting in positive feedback from clients
* Build on current platform knowledge by learning new modules and broadening skillset
* Continue learning service delivery solutions, technologies, and methodologies
* Maintain professionalism and an uninterrupted work environment during all client meetings and interactions
* Uphold excellent time management and organizational skills with an aptitude for creative problem\-solving.
* Remain innovative, creative, self\-directed…a great leader and team player with a record of accomplishment in managing multiple complex tasks
* Utilize strong communication, presentation, and writing skills
* Maintain current certifications, keep up to date on all Delta releases

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS:**

* Experience with Web Technologies (XML, HTML/CSS, AJAX, JavaScript, Web Services, etc.).
* Experience and deep understanding of ServiceNow Workflows and Flow Designer tools.
* Deep knowledge of KM, Portal, Content, Now Assist, AI Control Tower, A2A, MCP Server, HRSD, ITSM, ITOM, DevOps, and SecOps.
* Good understanding of ITIL processes.
* Good understanding of agile and hybrid Project Management methodologies.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow instance design and administration.
* Experience in an enterprise environment with multiple integration points.
* Strong analytical skills to identify problems and recommend solutions that meet business requirements.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with users, stakeholders, and team members.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.
* Must be a team player to work with architects, platform administrators, and process owners.
* Experience in ServiceNow administration and development.
* Hands\-on development, management, and deployment experience with ServiceNow.
* Troubleshooting, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.


Must know tools like Excel, Visio, and other Microsoft products.
Qualifications:
**KEY QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCES:**

* At least 10 \+ years’ experience in developing and administrating the ServiceNow Platform.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or another related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Broad exposure to IT infrastructure and application landscape, ideally with technical depth in a discipline/ITSM process.
* JavaScript: 5 Years minimum.

 **Certifications Preferred:*** ServiceNow certified Master Architect (preferred), Certified Technical Architect( must)
* ServiceNow Admin and Developer certified in and working experience at least two or more modules (ITSM, HRSD,CSM, GRC, HR, SecOps)

 **Differentiating Behavior, Leadership Skills:**

* Proactively research and resolve potential issues related to ServiceNow solution
* Curiosity and the ability and willingness to figure out something new maybe that they’ve never seen before
* Ability to deal with competing priorities while staying productive
* Strategic thinker focused on business value results that utilize technical solutions
* Skilled at conflict resolution and problem\-solving to achieve win\-win outcomes
* Ability to influence and motivate others using personal rather than positional power
* An outside\-in focus: outstanding end\-customer relationship skills
