title: UX Designer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UX Designer based in India.**
 Join a small, high\-ownership design team shaping how people discover and shop through AI\-powered experiences on connected TVs. You will own user experiences end to end, from understanding the underlying problem to delivering polished, production\-ready solutions. The role combines user\-centered thinking, interaction design, visual craft, prototyping, and close collaboration with product and engineering teams. You will tackle a relatively unexplored design space where traditional mobile patterns cannot simply be transferred to the living room. Your work will influence how commerce, discovery, and AI come together on large screens and remote\-driven interfaces. This is an opportunity to work in an ambitious environment where designers have meaningful ownership and are expected to bring both creativity and strong product judgment.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Understand user needs and product objectives before beginning design work, challenging assumptions and clarifying the underlying problem to be solved.
* Explore multiple design directions, communicate the reasoning behind different approaches, and make informed decisions based on user needs, product goals, and technical considerations.
* Design complete end\-to\-end experiences rather than isolated screens, accounting for loading, empty, error, first\-use, offline, and other important states.
* Create polished user interfaces within an established design system, extending existing patterns thoughtfully when new interaction requirements arise.
* Prototype interactions when static designs are insufficient, particularly for motion, navigation, focus behavior, and remote\-driven interactions on connected TV experiences.
* Work closely with product managers and engineers throughout development, maintaining design quality from initial concept through implementation and launch.
* Present design rationale clearly through the most effective artifacts, including user flows, prototypes, comparisons, and other visual or interactive explorations.
* Participate actively in design critiques, provide constructive feedback, collaborate with peers, and contribute to a supportive and high\-performing design culture.
* Take ownership of edge cases and interaction details that can significantly affect the usability and quality of large\-screen experiences.
* Help explore emerging opportunities for AI as a design material and contribute to new interaction paradigms for AI\-powered consumer products.


**Requirements**
* Approximately 2–4 years of experience designing consumer\-facing digital products, with shipped work that demonstrates your ability to take designs from concept through production.
* A strong portfolio that demonstrates design thinking and decision\-making, including the alternatives considered, trade\-offs made, and lessons learned—not just polished final screens.
* Strong visual and interaction design skills, with high standards for craft and the judgment to know when additional refinement adds value.
* Experience designing complete user journeys and accounting for complex interaction states, rather than focusing exclusively on happy\-path experiences.
* Comfort working with ambiguity and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and define problems when requirements are not fully specified.
* Ability to collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and other stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and incorporate constructive feedback.
* Curiosity about AI and an interest in exploring AI as a fundamental design material rather than simply adding AI\-powered features to existing experiences.
* Experience designing for connected TV, OTT platforms, or other large\-screen interfaces is an advantage but is not required.
* A pragmatic approach to design tools, with a focus on sound judgment, user outcomes, and product quality rather than attachment to any particular software.


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to work on emerging AI\-powered commerce and discovery experiences.
* High ownership within a deliberately small design team, with meaningful responsibility for real product surfaces.
* Opportunity to shape new interaction patterns for connected TV and large\-screen experiences.
* Exposure to AI, consumer technology, e\-commerce, and emerging digital product experiences.
* Close collaboration with product and engineering teams throughout the full product lifecycle.
* Opportunity to work on products reaching large and diverse consumer audiences.
* A creative environment that values experimentation, strong design craft, thoughtful decision\-making, and constructive critique.
* Opportunity to contribute to a relatively new design space without being constrained by an established playbook.
* Competitive compensation and benefits, subject to the applicable employment package.
* India\-based opportunity with a Bangalore location.

title: Global IT Data Architect Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do

* Define architecture for key domains within the Data Products Portfolio.
* Evaluate data related tools and technologies and recommend appropriate implementation patterns and standard methodologies to ensure our Data ecosystem is always modern.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Data Architects in establishing and adhering to enterprise standards while also performing PoCs to ensure those standards are implemented.
* Provide technical expertise and mentorship to Data Engineers and Data Analysts in the Data \& Solution Architecture.
* Develop and maintain processes, standards, policies, guidelines, and governance to ensure that a consistent framework and set of standards is applied across the company.
* Create and maintain conceptual / logical and Physica; data models to identify key business entities and visual relationships.
* Work with business and IT teams to understand data requirements.
* Maintain a data dictionary consisting of table and column definitions.
* Review Architecture with both technical and business audiences.
* Partner with Technology, Data Stewards and various Products teams in an Agile work stream while meeting program goals and deadlines.
* Champion architecture across the project lifecycle — working closely with Product Owners, Business, and BI\&A teams as a trusted technical partner to shape and steer key decisions.
* Ability to put forward well\-researched design approaches with clear pros and cons, evaluate and test new platform capabilities, and establish modern architectural ways of working across the team.
* Ability to craft \& influcence well\-structured proposals and present architectural recommendations persuasively, building stakeholder confidence and driving adoption of scalable, future\-ready solutions.
* Lead to design / build new models to efficiently deliver the candidate and recuitment results to senior management.

  

What You'll Bring

**Essential Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Bachelor's degree in information science, data management, computer science or related field preferred.

**Essential Experience \& Job Requirements**

* 12\+ years of IT experience with major focus on data warehouse / database related projects.
* Expertise in cloud data platforms and databases like Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, data catalog, MDM etc.
* Expertise in writing SQL and database procedures.
* Proficient in designing solution architecture factoring in all integration points, data flows and security/vulnerabilities.
* Proficient in Data Modelling \- conceptual, logical, and physical modelling.
* Proficient in documenting all the architecture related work performed.
* Hands on experience in data storage, ETL / ELT and data analytics tools and technologies e.g., Talend, dbt, Attunity, Golden Gate, Fivetran, APIs, Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx etc.
* Experienced in Data Warehousing design / development and BI / Analytical systems.
* Experience working projects using Agile methodologies.
* Strong hands\-on experience with data and analytics data architecture, solution design, and engineering experience.
* Experience with Cloud Big Data technologies such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Experience with Python would be preferable.
* Experience working with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and Meta Scrum with cross\-functional teams (Product Owners, Scrum Master, Architects, and data SMEs).
* Review existing databases, data architecture, data models across multiple systems and propose architecture enhancements for cross compatibility and target systems.
* Excellent written, oral communication and presentation skills to present architecture, features, and solution recommendations.

**GOOD TO HAVE: GENAI, AGENTIC AI \& EMERGING ARCHITECTURE CAPABILITIES**


These GenAI capabilities are optional / preferred and are captured separately from the core Data Architect requirements above.

  

* Hands\-on experience designing, evaluating, or supporting GenAI / LLM\-enabled solutions, including proofs of concept and production\-oriented architecture patterns.
* Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, multi\-step orchestration, tool\-using AI agents, and human\-in\-the\-loop design considerations.
* Experience with retrieval architectures such as RAG, GraphRAG, hybrid search, semantic search, and context\-grounding approaches for enterprise use cases.
* Familiarity with vector databases, knowledge graphs, metadata\-rich knowledge stores, and enterprise knowledge base design for AI applications.
* Exposure to AI application frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangChain and LangGraph.
* Awareness of agent\-to\-agent interaction patterns, A2A concepts, model context management (MCP), and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP.
* Experience evaluating data readiness for GenAI use cases, including chunking strategy, retrieval quality, data lineage, access controls, and content governance.
* Understanding of prompt design, evaluation approaches, observability, guardrails, safety, and responsible AI controls in enterprise environments.
* Ability to partner with product, engineering, architecture, and governance teams to shape scalable GenAI\-enabled data products and platforms.

  

Who You'll Work With

* Global functional portfolio technical leaders (Finance, HR, Marketing, Legal, Risk, IT), product owners, functional area teams across levels.
* Global Data portfolio Management \& teams (Enterprise Data Model, Data Catalog, Master Data Management).
* Consulting and internal Data Tribe teams across BCG.

  

Additional info

**You're Good at:**

* Design, document \& train the team on the overall processes and process flows for the data products’ architecture.
* Resolve technical challenges in critical situations that require immediate resolution.
* Develop relationships with external stakeholders to maintain awareness of data and security issues and trends.
* Review work from other tech team members and provide feedback for growth.
* Implement Data Architecture and Data security policies that align with governance objectives and regulatory requirements.

*"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*  

  

*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*  

  

*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

**Job description** 




  





**Role Purpose** 




 To manage end\-to\-end plant administration, contract labour operations, statutory compliance coordination, employee relations, and industrial relations activities to ensure smooth plant operations, legal compliance, and a healthy work environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Plant Administration** 



* Ensure overall housekeeping and hygiene standards across the plant premises.
* Manage canteen operations and ensure quality, hygiene, and employee satisfaction.
* Coordinate employee transportation and vendor management.
* Arrange hotel bookings and travel logistics for visitors, auditors, and employees.
* Coordinate plant engagement activities, sports events, celebrations, and welfare initiatives.
* Monitor administration vendors and ensure adherence to service level agreements.
* Ensure timely resolution of administration\-related employee concerns.



  





**2\. Contract Labour Management** 



* Track daily contractual manpower deployment across departments.
* Coordinate manpower allocation, adjustment, and reshuffling based on production requirements.
* Conduct daily meetings with contractor supervisors for manpower planning and issue resolution.
* Verify contractor attendance, deployment records, and productivity reports.
* Scrutinize contractor bills before processing for payment.
* Monitor contractor statutory compliance documents including:
* PF
* ESIC
* Bonus
* Wage Registers
* Labour Licences
* Insurance
* Ensure contractors comply with all statutory and company requirements.



  





**3\. Statutory Compliance \& Government Portal Management** 




 Manage and coordinate statutory filings, renewals, and compliance through various government portals, including:
 


* DISH (Directorate of Industrial Safety \& Health)
* Labour Department Portals
* Employment Exchange
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employee State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Maintaining statutory records and registers.
* Coordinating inspections by government authorities.
* Timely submission of returns and statutory reports.
* Supporting licence renewals and regulatory documentation.
* Maintaining compliance trackers and audit readiness.



  





**4\. Employee Relations** 



* Handle day\-to\-day employee grievances and workplace concerns.
* Support disciplinary actions in accordance with company policies.
* Coordinate domestic enquiries and disciplinary proceedings.
* Prepare documentation related to misconduct, warning letters, show\-cause notices, suspension letters, and enquiry proceedings.
* Liaise with internal stakeholders to ensure timely closure of employee issues.
* Maintain positive employee relations through effective communication and grievance handling.



  





**5\. Industrial Relations (IR)** 



* Support management in maintaining cordial industrial relations.
* Coordinate and attend meetings with internal union representatives.
* Assist in negotiations and discussions with union representatives.
* Maintain records of union meetings and action points.
* Coordinate implementation of settlements and agreed action items.
* Assist during labour inspections and statutory audits.
* Support management in handling labour\-related disputes and industrial issues.



  





**6\. Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Maintain MIS related to administration, contract labour, and statutory compliance.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly manpower reports.
* Maintain employee and contractor records.
* Generate reports for management review.
* Ensure proper filing and documentation of statutory and IR records.



  





**Qualification** 



* Graduate in any discipline
* MBA/MSW/PGDM in Human Resources or Labour Welfare preferred
* Knowledge of Labour Laws and Factory Administration will be an added advantage.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* 100% statutory compliance within timelines.
* Timely contractor bill verification and processing.
* Effective contract manpower deployment with minimum shortages.
* Housekeeping, canteen, and transport service quality.
* Timely closure of employee grievances.
* Successful coordination of domestic enquiries and disciplinary proceedings.
* Positive industrial relations and effective union coordination.
* Zero major compliance observations during audits and inspections.
* Timely submission of statutory returns and maintenance of records.

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills and confidence working with detailed HR and payroll\-related data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing multiple HR processes simultaneously.
* Ability to work fully on\-site from our Nagpur office.



**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience with HRMS, attendance, payroll or recruitment systems.
* Exposure to technical recruitment.
* Experience preparing payroll and variable\-pay inputs.
* Working knowledge of employment practices and HR compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting performance management, PIPs and employee grievances.



**Personal Attributes** 



* Exceptional attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Approachable and capable of building employee trust.
* Discreet and mature when handling confidential information.
* Structured, dependable and disciplined about timelines.
* Comfortable following up firmly to obtain information and ensure process compliance.
* Willing to work hands\-on rather than merely coordinate or supervise activities.



**What Success Looks Like** 



* Accurate and timely HR, attendance, timesheet and payroll\-related data.
* Consistent closure of HR processes without missed deadlines or follow\-ups.
* Timely hiring for junior and mid\-level positions.

* Employees experience HR as approachable, dependable and professional.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Business Analyst** 




  





 We're looking for a Business Analyst who solves problems through data and uses AI tools as a core part of how they work, not as an occasional shortcut. The domain changes depending on what the business needs: operations, marketing, customer experience etc. The core skill stays the same \- take a messy, open\-ended question and come back with a clear, data\-backed answer.
 



  





 For example: "returns are up 20% in Hyderabad this month." A report\-runner tells you the number went up. The person we want figures out why. They pull return\-reason data, cross\-reference it with recent product launches or store changes, use an AI tool to quickly scan through hundreds of customer complaints for patterns, and come back with "it's sizing issues on the new collection, mostly from online orders."
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  





 \* Answer open business questions end to end \- from figuring out the right data to pull, to the analysis, to a clear recommendation.
 



 \* Proactively spot problems and opportunities in the data before someone asks. A sudden drop in repeat purchases, an SKU that's quietly outperforming, a warehouse that's consistently late.
 



 \* Understand the actual business process behind the numbers, not just the numbers themselves. Know how inventory moves, how a campaign reaches a customer, how a return gets processed \- so your analysis catches what a pure data person would miss.
 



 \* Use AI tools to move faster \- exploring data, testing hypotheses, scanning unstructured feedback for patterns, drafting reports. Always verify the output before sharing.
 



 \* Build automated reports or dashboards for questions that keep coming up, so people don't have to ask you every time.
 



 \* Document your analyses and methods so they're reusable. The next person (or future you) should be able to pick up where you left off without starting from scratch.
 



 \* Present findings in plain language \- what the data means and what to do about it, not just numbers and charts.
 



 \* Work with different teams (marketing, retail, supply chain, etc.) to understand the real question behind what they're asking.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




  





 \* 1\-3 years of experience in business analysis, data analysis, or a similar role.
 



 \* Comfortable writing and optimizing SQL to pull and join data.
 



 \* Actually used AI tools to get real work done faster, not just tried them once.
 



 \* Can take a vague, open\-ended question and break it into a clear plan on your own.
 



 \* Curious enough to dig into how something works, not just what the data says.
 



 \* Comfortable juggling a few requests at once without dropping any of them.

title: Analyst-Risk Management
description:
**Job Description**
 Credit and Fraud Risk (CFR) team helps drive profitable business growth by reducing the risk of fraud and maintaining industry lowest credit loss rates. It uses an array of tools and ever\-evolving technology to detect and combat fraud, minimize the disruption of good spending, and provide a world\-class customer experience. The team leads efforts that leverage data and digital advancements to improve risk management as well as enable commerce and drive innovation.
   

  

 A single decision can have many outcomes. And when that decision affects millions of customers, it needs to be the right one. That’s where our Credit \& Fraud Risk (CFR) Analytics \& Data Science CoE team comes in. The team leads efforts that leverage data and digital advancements to improve risk management as well as enable commerce and drive innovation, every day. Right from targeting the right customer for our products to underwriting them to managing their experience with Amex when they get onboarded, every decision is advised by groundbreaking analytics \& data science. We help the company grow its business profitably while delivering the world's best customer experience, all powered by data. We are the backbone of all financial services operations at American Express and impact every aspect of the company.
   

  

 As a part of the team, you’ll have the opportunity to work in one of the best companies for data scientists in the country. You will solve real world business problems while getting exposure to the industry’s top leaders in analytics, data science and machine learning. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems and crafting solutions that impact millions, you should consider a career in CFR.
   

  

**Description On The Role**
 Development, review and/or execution of economic logic \& analytical solutions to drive profitable credit business actions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Understand the core business of AXP and the levers behind various decisions
* Analyze large amounts of data to derive business insights and create innovative solutions
* Leverage the power of closed loop through Amex network to make decisions more intelligent and relevant
* Innovate with a focus on developing newer and better approaches using big data \& machine learning solution
* Clear articulation and structuring of business findings across prospect and customer domain to the leadership and key partners
* Maintain external lens and be aware of developments in the field of Finance/Payments/Analytics etc.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**
* MBA, Master’s Degree In Economics, Statistics, Computer Science Or related fields
* 0\-30 months of experience in analytics
* Ability to drive project deliverables to achieve business results
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Innovative problem solver with ability to learn quickly and work independently with complex, unstructured initiatives
* Ability to Integrate with Cross\-Functional Business Partners Worldwide


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
   

  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial\-well\-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on\-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Position Overview** 




  





 We are seeking a skilled Modeler to contribute to the development and optimization of marketing analytics models. You will work within a cross\-functional team to build propensity models, next\-best\-action (NBA) engines, customer segmentation frameworks, and campaign response models that power data\-driven marketing strategies. You will apply best practices in model explainability, fairness testing, and lifecycle governance to ensure high\-quality, compliant model outputs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and optimize propensity models, segmentation frameworks, and campaign response models using supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques.
* Conduct bias testing and implement model explainability methods (e.g., SHAP, LIME) to support model approval and governance workflows.
* Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering to identify meaningful predictors of customer behavior.
* Support the full model lifecycle including development, documentation, validation support, performance monitoring, and periodic re\-validation.
* Collaborate with marketing and data teams to understand business objectives and translate them into modeling requirements.
* Prepare clear, concise model documentation including methodology overviews, performance summaries, and limitation disclosures.
* Monitor deployed models for data drift, performance degradation, and champion\-challenger evaluation.
* Contribute to A/B test design and campaign measurement analyses to evaluate marketing effectiveness.
* Stay current on advances in marketing data science, uplift modeling, and customer analytics.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 3–6 years of experience in data science, analytics, or quantitative modeling with a focus on customer or marketing analytics.
* Hands\-on experience building and evaluating classification and regression models for propensity scoring or segmentation.
* Proficiency in Python with working knowledge of libraries such as scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, pandas, and numpy.
* Familiarity with model explainability tools (SHAP, LIME) and basic concepts of model fairness and bias testing.
* Experience with SQL and large\-scale data platforms for data extraction and feature preparation.
* Understanding of model validation principles and documentation standards.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills for presenting model results to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree (Master's preferred) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.



  





**Model Lifecycle \& Governance** 




 This role supports end\-to\-end model lifecycle management. Responsibilities encompass model development, independent validation and assessment, performance optimization, monitoring, documentation, and governance — ensuring all models adhere to applicable standards and remain fit\-for\-purpose throughout their operational life.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a Generative AI – Engineer to join our growing team to help design, build, fine\-tune, and deploy cutting – edge generative AI models and agentic systems. You will work on the full lifecycle of foundational model development – involving both large and small language models (LLMs and SLMs) – to create scalable AI solutions that address diverse needs across different business domains. This role is ideal for proactive individuals with a strong foundation in machine learning and an experimental mindset, who are passionate about driving transformative advancements in generative AI from research to real\-world production impact.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and train foundational generative AI models across modalities such as text\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, automatic speech recognition, and vision language.
* Fine\-tune and adapt models for specific tasks and domains.
* Build and maintain pipelines for data curation, preprocessing, training, evaluation, and continuous improvement of models.
* Implement debugging, CI/CD, and observability to ensure reliability and efficiency across the development lifecycle.
* Develop retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and optimize prompt engineering strategies.
* Optimize training and inference performance through quantization, distributed training/inference, GPU/TPU acceleration.
* Monitor, benchmark, and improve model performance with a focus on accuracy, efficiency, and reducing hallucinations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to build robust AI stacks and integrate them seamlessly into production pipelines for deployment.
* Document technical processes, AI model architectures, and experimental results, while maintaining well\- structured, version\-controlled code repositories.
* Stay current with advancements in transformer architectures, open\-source releases, and AI tooling.



  





**Minimum Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science or any related field with 2 to 5 years of industry experience in applied machine learning or AI development.



  





**Required Expertise** 



* Proficiency in Python programming with solid foundation in computer science fundamentals such as data structures and algorithms.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and demonstrated ability to lead projects.
* Hands\-on experience with a few of the tools listed below:
* One or more model libraries and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, HF Transformers, NeMo, etc.
* AI application libraries and orchestration frameworks such as DSPy, Langgraph, Langchain, Llamaindex, etc.
* GPU/TPU based training and inference using libraries such as vLLM.
* Distributed training tools such as SLURM, Ray, Pytorch DDP, NCCL, etc.
* Version control, observability systems, and MLOps tools such as Git, DVC, W\&B, MLFlow, KubeFlow, etc.
* Data analysis and curation tools such as Dask, Milvus, Apache Spark, Numpy, etc.
* Chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus), and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG).
* Model context protocol (MCP), Agent to Agent (A2A), and Agent Communication Protocol (ACP).
* Team player with excellent interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively with remote team members.
* Go\-getter attitude and ability to flourish in a fast\-paced, startup environment.
* Prior experience of building and deploying LLMs or SLMs, experience with multimodal models, and track record of contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects would be a big plus.

title: Junior QA Automation Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Junior QA Engineer (Automation \& Manual Testing)
   

  

 Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh (On\-Site)
   

 Job Type: Full\-Time
   

 Salary: Rs. 20,000 – 30,000 / month (Based on experience)
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 We are seeking a proactive QA Engineer to establish a robust testing process for our software products. Your primary objective will be to prevent broken updates from reaching production by creating test cases, performing regression testing on Pull Requests, and introducing basic automated testing suites.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \- PR Testing: Test every Pull Request in a staging environment before it gets approved for production.
   

 \- Regression Testing: Build and maintain a checklist/suite of core product features to ensure zero regressions after code updates.
   

 \- Automated Testing: Write basic automated test scripts (unit/integration/E2E) using tools like Postman, Jest, Cypress, or Selenium.
   

 \- Bug Documentation: Document steps to reproduce bugs clearly and work directly with developers to resolve them promptly.
   

 \- Release Verification: Validate production deployments to ensure stable performance.
   

  

 Tech Stack You'll Work With
   

  

 Our product is a WhatsApp\-native AI platform — most testing happens at the API, queue, and conversation\-flow level rather than on a traditional web UI.
   

  

 Core (Must Have)
   

  

 \- API Testing — Postman / Insomnia: REST API testing, collections, environments, assertions, mock servers.
   

 \- Jest (Node.js): Running and writing unit/integration tests; understanding mock fixtures and test coverage reports.
   

 \- Git \& GitHub: Pulling developer branches, checking out PRs, testing locally/on staging; basic GitHub Actions awareness.
   

 \- MongoDB basics: Querying collections to verify data was actually written correctly after an action (not just that the app said so).
   

 \- Test documentation: Clear repro steps, expected vs actual, severity tagging (P0–P3\).
   

  

 Good to Have
   

  

 \- WhatsApp / messaging flow testing: Webhooks, message delivery, multi\-user conversation scenarios, reply\-chain edge cases.
   

 \- Redis \& BullMQ awareness: Understanding job queues enough to verify retries, delayed jobs, and scheduled reminders actually fire.
   

 \- E2E automation — Cypress / Playwright / Selenium: For dashboard and web\-console flows.
   

 \- Testing AI/LLM outputs: Verifying bot responses against expected behaviour, catching hallucinated confirmations, prompt regression checks.
   

 \- Multilingual testing: Hindi/Hinglish/Devanagari input handling — our users type in mixed languages, and so should your test cases.
   

 \- CI/CD basics: GitHub Actions pipelines, pre\-merge test gates.
   

  

 Requirements
   

  

 \- Experience: 1–2 years in QA testing (Manual \+ basic Automation).
   

 \- Tools Knowledge: Hands\-on experience with API testing (Postman/Insomnia) and basic UI automation frameworks.
   

 \- Testing Mindset: Ability to think like an end\-user while anticipating edge cases where code might break.
   

 \- Git Basics: Basic knowledge of Git to pull developer branches and test them locally or on staging.
   

 \- Location: Must be based in or willing to relocate to Indore for an on\-site role.

description:

 Full\-Time

 Work from Office
 







 About Axtroid
 
 Axtroid is an Indian technology company focused on advanced manufacturing and Industry 4\.0 technologies, including 3D printing, drones, robotics, and extended reality (XR). We work with educational institutions, industries, and government organizations across India to deliver complete technology solutions backed by strong technical and customer support.
 



 As we continue to grow, we are looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant who can help the CEO stay organized, focused, and productive.
 







 About the Role
 
 As a Quality Analyst, you will be responsible for testing Axtroid's hardware and software products before they are released to customers. Your work will directly improve product quality, reliability and user experience by identifying defects, reproducing issues and working closely with engineering teams to resolve them.
 



 This is a hands\-on role involving both hardware and software testing.
 







 Key Responsibilities
 * Perform functional testing of desktop 3D printers, including setup, calibration, printing and validation of print quality.
* Test 3D scanners for accuracy, ease of use, repeatability and software integration.
* Test XR applications running on VR headsets and identify usability, performance and functional issues.
* Test drones, flight software and supporting applications according to defined test procedures.
* Develop detailed test plans, test cases and test checklists for new products and software releases.
* Execute regression testing before product releases.
* Identify, reproduce, document and report bugs with clear steps, screenshots, videos and logs.
* Verify bug fixes and ensure issues have been resolved.
* Perform hardware inspection and quality checks before products are shipped.
* Evaluate products from the customer's perspective and recommend usability improvements.
* Maintain accurate records of testing activities and quality reports.
* Work closely with product managers, software developers and hardware engineers to improve overall product quality.



  




 Required Skills
 * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to systematically investigate and reproduce issues.
* Good written communication and documentation skills.
* Comfortable working with both hardware and software.
* Ability to follow structured testing procedures.
* Basic understanding of Windows and Android operating systems.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.



  




 Preferred Qualifications
 * Bachelor's degree or diploma in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics or a related field.
* Experience in software testing or quality assurance is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Exposure to 3D printing, CAD, drones, robotics, gaming, XR or consumer electronics will be an added advantage.
* Fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude are encouraged to apply.



  




 What You'll Work With
 * Desktop 3D printers
* Industrial\-grade 3D scanners
* Virtual Reality headsets
* XR learning applications
* Educational drones
* Desktop and mobile applications
* Prototype hardware and pre\-release software



  




 What We're Looking For
 
 We're looking for someone who:
 


* Enjoys breaking things to make products better.
* Notices small details that others miss.
* Takes ownership of quality.
* Is patient, organised and methodical.
* Loves working with emerging technologies.
* Wants to build products that customers can trust.



  




 Why Join Axtroid?
 * Work with cutting\-edge technologies including 3D Printing, XR and Drones.
* Be part of a fast\-growing technology company.
* Work directly with engineers and product designers.
* Gain exposure to hardware, software and immersive technologies.
* Opportunity to influence products used by schools, universities and industries across India.



 If you're passionate about quality and want to help build world\-class technology products, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  




 How to Apply
 
 Please submit:
 


* Your resume
* A brief cover letter explaining why you believe you are an excellent fit for this role
* Your current and expected salary
* Your notice period
* Your current location








**Important:** 
 We are looking for someone who takes pride in accuracy. Applications containing spelling mistakes, grammatical errors, incomplete information, or poorly formatted resumes are unlikely to be considered. Attention to detail is one of the most important requirements for this position.

 experience \& below requirements

title: Software QA Engineer, Test Automation
description:
**We are Siemens**
 Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
   

  

 We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence.
   

  

 In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence.
   

  

 You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages.
* Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases.
* Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery.
* Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable.
* Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution.
* Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage.
* Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing, with hands\-on experience in test automation.
* Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language, with the ability to develop maintainable automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Katalon Studio, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent.
* Experience with API testing and database validation, including RESTful APIs, SQL queries, and tools such as Postman or Swagger.
* Familiarity with SPARQL and RDF/knowledge graph concepts, including the ability to write or assess SPARQL queries for data retrieval and validation.
* Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI, or equivalent, with an understanding of integrating automated tests into pipelines.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, and BDD, combined with strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.


**Preferred Skills**
* Exposure to AI agents, LLM\-driven applications, or AI\-assisted automation, including technologies such as Anthropic Claude or equivalent.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
* Familiarity with security testing practices such as DAST and penetration testing concepts.
* Experience testing browser\-based applications, including functionality, performance, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Experience or interest in Data Science, Data Visualization, Data Analytics, RDF, or Knowledge Graph technologies.
* Experience with defect and test management tools such as JIRA, X\-Ray, TestRail, or Zephyr.


**Why Us**
 At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work \- hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

 Software, ecommerce, retail, supply chain and customer experience all come together in Order Management, and that's exactly where this role sits.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Lepton Software:** 




 Lepton Software is a leading provider of Location Intelligence, Smart Mapping, and GIS\-based software solutions, empowering enterprises across Telecom, BFSI, Government, Retail, and Automotive sectors. With over 25\+ years of expertise, Lepton delivers innovative geospatial products, network planning solutions, and enterprise\-grade digital transformation services across global markets. Our culture encourages ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer\-centric innovation.
 



  





**(A) JOB SUMMARY** 




 Are you ready to start your career in DevOps and cloud infrastructure? We're looking for a Trainee DevOps Engineer / Junior DevOps Engineer to join us. This role is your launchpad into modern DevOps — you'll build a strong foundation in CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, containers, and monitoring, all with guidance from senior DevOps engineers. You'll:
 



 • Learn how CI/CD pipelines are set up and help keep them running smoothly
 



 • Assist in deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting applications
 



 • Get hands\-on exposure to cloud platforms, containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code
 



 • Help automate routine operational tasks
 



 We're looking for someone with a good grip on Linux, networking, and scripting basics, and genuine curiosity about cloud infrastructure, automation, and DevOps tooling — no prior work experience needed.
 



  





**(B) JOB DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITY** 




**1\. CI/CD Support** 




 • Help build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)

**2\. Cloud \& Infrastructure Exposure**

**3\. Containers \& Orchestration Basics** 




 • Learn Docker fundamentals — how to build, run, and manage containers
 



 • Get an introduction to Kubernetes concepts (pods, deployments, services)
 



 • Assist in deploying containerized applications in test/staging environments
 



  





**4\. Monitoring \& Incident Support** 




 • Learn to use monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and CloudWatch
 



 • Assist in setting up basic alerts and dashboards
 



 • Support senior engineers during incident triage and log analysis
 



 • Document runbooks and troubleshooting steps
 



  





**5\. Scripting \& Automation** 




 • Write basic automation scripts in Bash, Python, or PowerShell
 



 • Assist in automating repetitive operational tasks
 



 • Learn configuration management basics using Ansible or similar tools
 



  





**6\. Version Control \& Collaboration** 




 • Work with Git for version control of scripts, configs, and pipelines
 



 • Follow branching and code\-review practices used by the team
 



 • Log and track tasks and issues in Jira
 



  





**7\. Learning \& Development** 




 • Pick up networking fundamentals — DNS, load balancing, firewalls
 



 • Build understanding of security basics in DevOps (secrets management, access control)
 



 • Participate in training sessions on cloud, automation, and DevOps best practices
 



 • Seek feedback and continuously improve technical skills
 



  





**(C) QUALIFICATION \& SKILLSET** 




**Core DevOps Knowledge** 




 • 0\-1 years of experience — internships or academic/personal projects in DevOps or cloud are a bonus, not a requirement
 



 • Good grasp of Linux/Unix systems and the command line
 



 • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS)
 



 • Willingness to learn CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
 



  





**Programming \& Technical Aptitude** 




 • Basic scripting knowledge in Bash, Python, or PowerShell
 



 • Familiarity with Git and version control workflows
 



 • Good analytical and problem\-solving skills
 



  





**Cloud \& Container Awareness (Good to Have)** 




 • Basic familiarity with a cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP) — free\-tier or coursework exposure is fine
 



 • Conceptual understanding of Docker and containers
 



 • Interest in Kubernetes and container orchestration
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 




 • Exposure to Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation)
 



 • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
 



 • Relevant certifications (AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals, etc.)
 



 • Interest in geospatial/GIS or telecom infrastructure systems
 



  





**EDUCATION** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Engineering / IT or related field
 



 • Cloud fundamentals certification (AWS/Azure/GCP) is a plus (not mandatory)
 



  





**GROWTH TRAITS** 




 • Strong eagerness to learn and grow in DevOps and cloud engineering
 



 • Comfort working with command\-line tools and troubleshooting
 



 • Good communication and collaboration skills
 



 • Openness to feedback and mentorship
 



 • Proactive approach to picking up new tools and technologies
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 • A structured entry point into a modern, cloud\-first DevOps career path
 



 • Direct mentorship from senior DevOps engineers and exposure to real production systems
 



 • Opportunity to build strong infrastructure and automation fundamentals on enterprise\-grade products
 



 • Clear growth path toward cloud, SRE, and platform engineering roles
 



  





**Why Join Lepton Software:** 




 • Fast\-paced, growth\-focused environment
 



 • Real mentorship from senior DevOps engineers, right from day one
 



 • Hands\-on exposure to cloud, containers, and modern automation tools
 



 • A supportive, learning\-first culture built for early\-career professionals

 Practical understanding of Git workflows and building automated pipeline workflows.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Summary
 



 We are seeking a skilled and proactive DevOps Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and automated infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in cloud platforms, container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, security best practices, and deployment automation across modern web applications.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins.
* Deploy, manage, and monitor applications on AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Build and maintain Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads using Docker.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and deployment processes.
* Manage application deployments for Next.js, WordPress, PHP, Python, and JavaScript\-based applications.
* Configure and maintain web servers such as Nginx and Apache.
* Implement infrastructure security, IAM policies, SSL/TLS certificates, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot production issues, and ensure high availability.
* Collaborate with development, QA, and security teams to streamline release processes.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation and follow DevOps best practices.



 Required Skills
 


* 3–5 years of hands\-on DevOps experience.
* Strong experience with AWS services (EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, EKS, CloudWatch, Route 53, ELB).
* Expertise in Kubernetes and Docker.
* Experience creating and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong Linux administration and shell scripting skills.
* Experience deploying and managing Next.js, WordPress, PHP, Python, and JavaScript applications.
* Good understanding of Git and version control workflows.
* Experience with Nginx/Apache configuration and reverse proxy setup.
* Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or CloudWatch.
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills.



 Preferred Skills
 


* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation).
* Knowledge of Ansible or similar configuration management tools.
* Experience with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD.
* Familiarity with security scanning tools and DevSecOps practices.
* Knowledge of Helm, Argo CD, or Flux CD.
* Experience with databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Business Title** 
 : DevOps Engineer
   

  

**Company Overview:**
 Intelligent Manufacturing addresses the customers’ full value chain from design and planning to verification with a combination of overarching and point\-solutions.  We shape the future of manufacturing by connecting and automating the component manufacturing value chain. By providing open and agnostic end\-to\-end solutions and  shaping new markets with partners in our collaboration network, making the shift towards more efficient and sustainable manufacturing possible
   

  

**We Build Software That Shapes How the World Makes Things**
 Somewhere right now, an engineer at an aerospace company is validating a jet engine component. A team at an automotive plant is catching a defect before it reaches the line. A precision manufacturer is closing the loop between their CAD design and the physical world — in real time.
   

  

 That's possible because of software like ours. And this also shows what software quality means to us.
   

  

 At Metrologic Group, part of Sandvik — a global industrial technology leader — we build the software backbone of modern manufacturing quality. Our solutions connect design, production, and inspection into a seamless digital feedback loop, used by 15,000\+ engineers across 60 countries, including the world's top aerospace, automotive, and energy companies.
   

  

 We're growing our engineering team in Pune, and we're looking for a developer who wants to do more than maintain code — someone who wants to build something that matters.
   

  

**Job Purpose** 
 :
   

  

 Our software tackles genuinely hard problems — real\-time 3D geometry processing, inspection flow, tolerance analysis, machine interfacing, and complex visualization — at the intersection of precision engineering and modern software architecture.
   

  

 The DevOps Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and deployment processes on Cloud. The role focuses on enabling secure, scalable, and reliable application delivery while supporting development teams and driving DevOps best practices across the organization.
   

  

**Location** 
 : Pune, India
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
***Activities***
* Design, implement, and maintain DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
* Manage environments across development, testing, staging, and production.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployments.
* Monitor application \& CI/CD health, logs, and performance metrics.
* Troubleshoot build, release, infrastructure, and runtime issues.
* Support release management and production deployments along with S/W Developers.
* Ensure security, backup, and compliance practices are followed.
* Write and maintain technical documentation on DevOps Architecture


***Design \& Development***
* Should have good understanding on OS (Linux and Windows)
* Middleware microsoft, opensource
* Design and manage infrastructure using “Infrastructure as Code (IaC)” tools.
* Implement containerization and orchestration using Docker.
* Configure and optimize DevOps pipelines, repositories, artifacts, and boards.
* Implement monitoring and logging
* Configure security best practices including secrets management and policy enforcement.
* Automated test product (TestComplete, Selenium, Playwrite etc.)


***Collaboration \& Delivery***
* Collaborate closely with software developers, QA, security, and architecture teams.
* Participate actively in Agile/Scrum events.
* Enable development teams with efficient build and release workflows.
* Communicate deployment plans, risks, and operational issues clearly.
* Assist with incident management and root cause analysis for production issues.


***Contribution to Team \& Continuous Improvement***
* Continuously identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive processes.
* Improve system reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Contribute to DevOps standards, documentation, and best practices.
* Mentor \& onboard new engineers and DevOps concepts.
* Stay current with DevOps services, tools, and cloud innovations.
* Participate in reducing technical debt and improving operational maturity.


**Qualifications, Experience \& Domain**
***Educational Background***
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, master’s in computer applications (MCA), or an equivalent qualification.


**Experience \& Technical Skills**
* 5 \+ years of proven experience in DevOps in a similar role \& Strong experience with Cloud services
* App Services, Virtual Machines, AKS, Storage Accounts, Containerization configuration
* Networking (VNETs, NSGs, Load Balancers)
* Security fundamentals: RBAC, Key Vault, Managed Identities
* Exposure to managing high‑availability, scalable systems
* Experience with Cloud Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics
* Setting up alerts, dashboards, and log queries
* Proven experience supporting CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and production environments
* Hands‑on experience with DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Artifacts, Boards)
* CI/CD pipeline authoring using YAML
* Experience with Git\-based version control and branching strategies
* Should have proven experience in setting up GitHub
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Experience automating infrastructure provisioning and configuration
* Security \& Reliability
* Understanding of DevOps, secrets management, and compliance controls
* Experience with backups, disaster recovery, and high‑availability setups


***Soft Skills***
* Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills.
* Groom \& Mentor mindset
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work and handle production responsibilities.
* Ownership mindset with focus on quality and reliability.
* Adaptable to fast‑changing cloud and DevOps environments.
* Continuous learning attitude with attention to detail.


***What Success Looks Like***
 A successful Software Developer will:
   

  

* Deliver high‑quality, stable, and scalable software features aligned with business and customer needs.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code that meets defined coding and architectural standards.
* Actively contributes to design decisions that improve usability, performance, and system architecture.
* Collaborate effectively with QA and cross‑functional teams to ensure timely and defect‑free releases.
* Proactively identify and resolve technical issues, minimizing rework and technical debt.
* Contribute to continuous improvement through innovation, refactoring, and process enhancements.
* Be recognized as a reliable team player and technical contributor, supporting both project delivery and team growth.
* You don’t need to know metrology on “day one” – but you will find it genuinely fascinating – we promise!


**A glimpse of our culture**
 At Sandvik, we're tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial! For us, success is a team effort \- we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. We also give you the freedom to find that perfect mix between work, family life and interests. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.
   

  

**Why Join Us**
* Real impact — your code runs in factories, labs, and quality departments at companies
* Global team, local home — Pune\-based role with genuine collaboration with engineering teams in Europe and worldwide
* Technical depth — complex domain, interesting problems, room to grow and develop
* Stability and scale — backed by Sandvik, a 160\-year\-old industrial technology company operating in 150\+ countries
* Room to lead — as the Pune team grows, so does the opportunity to take on more ownership

We're guided by a deep empathy for our customers and their needs, and we think carefully about how our users and our world may be affected by the decisions we make. We're constantly aiming to drive improvements for our users and build useful things that make our world better. We're looking for candidates comfortable in a high\-growth, fast\-paced environment. We value tenacity, a commitment to learning, empathy, humility, ambition, curiosity and a deep\-seated belief in the power of data to inform and improve how things get done and decisions get made.
 



  





 We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to be the operations counterpart of our senior platform engineering effort: the engineer who helps raise the bar on cloud and delivery practices across COMPLY and drive the reusable infrastructure capabilities and patterns that every product team builds on. The right candidate has strong cloud engineering chops, has built shared infrastructure components that other teams adopt, takes craft and reliability seriously, and uses AI development tools fluently to ship more, faster, without dropping the quality bar.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 You will help drive the cloud patterns, Terraform modules, pipelines and operational practices that make COMPLY's product teams faster and more reliable. That means understanding how teams build and deploy today, finding the duplication and the rough edges, designing reusable infrastructure building blocks that solve the same problem once and well, and partnering with engineers to bring them on board. You will spend your time roughly between hands\-on building of platform infrastructure, helping product teams adopt it, and shaping the practices (deployment, observability, security, incident response) that govern how we run in production.
 



 AI development tools are a core part of the job, not an extracurricular. You will use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar every day to accelerate Terraform authoring, pipeline design, scripting, debugging and review, and you will share what works back with the team, so AI\-assisted infrastructure engineering becomes a real practice, not personal preference. The bar on cloud and Terraform fundamentals stays high. AI accelerates good engineering, it does not replace it.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Reusable Cloud and Infrastructure Capabilities:** 



* Design, build and maintain shared Terraform modules in collaboration with operations teams, account and landing zone patterns, pipeline templates and reference architectures that product teams adopt across COMPLY.
* Identify cross\-cutting infrastructure concerns (networking, IAM, secrets, logging, telemetry, deployment, cost controls, environment promotion, multi\-account topology) and turn them into reusable building blocks with strong defaults.
* Define and document the patterns for how products consume platform infrastructure, including module versioning, deprecation and migration paths.
* Build internal developer\-facing tooling that makes the right thing the easy thing: paved\-road pipelines, scaffolds for new services, opinionated Terraform compositions, contract checks and golden\-path CI workflows.



  





**Ops Practices and Alignment:** 



* Help drive operational and delivery practices across teams: IaC review standards, deployment patterns, branching and release strategy, environment management, change management, incident response and post\-incident review.
* Partner with engineering leads to align on shared infrastructure decisions and prevent parallel reinvention of the same components across teams.
* Lead and contribute to design docs, architecture decision records and runbooks that the broader engineering org can rely on.
* Coach product teams adopting shared infrastructure and act as a sounding board on hard cloud, reliability and delivery problems.
* Define and improve SLOs, observability standards and on\-call ergonomics so production stays healthy and humane.



  





**Hands\-On Cloud and Delivery Engineering:** 



* Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using one of the tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Bitbucket Pipelines or AWS CodePipeline. Integrate automated testing, code quality checks, security scans and supply chain controls.
* Experience building IAC using Software Development patterns like encapsulation, abstraction, and composability to build scalable, extendable and stable infrastructure.
* Develop and manage infrastructure as code with Terraform, including writing and maintaining modular, reusable compositions used across teams.
* Manage and optimize cloud services hands\-on, including compute, storage, databases, networking, identity and observability.
* Implement cloud monitoring, logging and alerting to proactively catch reliability, security and cost issues.
* Implement and uphold security best practices and compliance requirements across pipelines and infrastructure, including secrets management, network segmentation, encryption and audit logging.



  





**AI\-Assisted Engineering:** 



* Use AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) as a serious part of your daily workflow for Terraform authoring, pipeline design, scripting, debugging, refactoring and review.
* Develop and share AI\-assisted infrastructure engineering practices with the team: prompt patterns that work, where to trust output, where to verify, how to keep the bar on cloud and Terraform fundamentals high while moving faster.
* Contribute back to COMPLY's internal AI scaffolding.



  





**Qualifications:** 




**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
 



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum of 3\-5 years of experience as a DevOps Engineer, SRE, cloud platform engineer or in a similar role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with either AWS or Azure as your primary cloud (depth in one is required; familiarity with the other is welcome but not necessary).
* Strong experience developing and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Bitbucket Pipelines or AWS CodePipeline.
* Demonstrated experience building shared infrastructure components, Terraform modules or internal platform tooling that other engineers adopted and relied on.
* Demonstrated hands\-on use of AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) in your day\-to\-day work, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they hurt.



  





**Technical Skills:** 



* Strong proficiency with infrastructure as code using Terraform, including writing, composing and maintaining reusable modules.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture patterns: networking, identity, multi\-account or multi\-subscription topology, environment promotion, secrets management, observability and cost controls.
* Experience with Compute, Storage, Databases, Networking, IAM and AI services in AWS or Azure
* Understanding of software engineering concepts like abstraction, encapsulation, composition etc to design and build reliable, stable, extendable infrastructure.
* Strong sense of software craft applied to infrastructure: readability, testability, modularity, backwards compatibility and the experience of the engineer who consumes your modules next.
* Strong verbal and written communication, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Understanding of security best practices and the ability to implement security measures across pipelines and cloud infrastructure.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Prior experience as a platform or developer productivity engineer in a multi\-team product organization.
* Experience defining versioning, deprecation and migration strategies for shared Terraform modules and pipeline templates consumed by many teams.
* Experience with one of the container orchestrations like ECS, EKS or AKS
* Familiarity with operating infrastructure for LLM, RAG or agent\-based systems (model gateways, MCP server hosting, vector stores, eval pipelines in CI).
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or similar certifications.
* Background in financial services, compliance or another regulated domain.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* A high\-impact role helping define how the entire COMPLY engineering organization runs in the cloud.
* The chance to ship infrastructure code, patterns and practices that other engineers rely on every day.
* A collaborative team that takes both operational craft and AI\-assisted engineering seriously.
* An environment where AI\-native engineering is the norm, with the autonomy to bring your own ideas about how to make it work well at scale.

description:
**Company Description**

**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Cloud Engineer / Solutions Architect with 3\-5 years of experience to own our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and overall IT environment. The ideal candidate will design and operate workloads across both AWS and Azure, build and maintain deployment pipelines for multiple products, and act as the go\-to person in the team for anything infrastructure, networking, or IT\-related. This is a broad, ownership\-heavy role combining solutions architecture, DevOps engineering, and internal IT support.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ·       Design, provision, and operate cloud infrastructure across both AWS and Azure including compute, storage, networking, databases, identity, and managed services.
 



 ·       Act as solutions architect for new initiatives like translate product and business requirements into well\-architected cloud designs covering scalability, security, availability, and cost.
 



 ·       Build, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines for multiple products using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps Pipelines.
 



 ·       Containerize applications using Docker and manage orchestration with Kubernetes (EKS / AKS) or equivalent managed services.
 



 ·       Define and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, or similar tools.

 ·       Own cloud and application security IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, vulnerability scanning, patching, and adherence to best practices.
 



 ·       Serve as the primary point of contact for the CISO / external security team, coordinate VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing) cycles, ISO 27001 and similar certification audits, security questionnaires, and remediation of findings.
 



 ·       Manage office and product networking, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, domain management, and connectivity between cloud and on\-prem environments.
 



 ·       Plan and execute backups, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures across cloud workloads.
 



 ·       Monitor and optimize cloud spend across AWS and Azure right\-sizing, reserved capacity, and cost reporting.
 



 ·       Collaborate closely with the Lead Developer, QA, and Product teams on release planning, environment management, and production rollouts.
 



 ·       Document architecture, runbooks, incident response procedures, and IT policies in Confluence or equivalent.
 



 ·       Respond to production incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and drive preventive improvements.
 



**Required Technical Skills** 




 ·       3–5 years of hands\-on experience as a Cloud / DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, with proven exposure to both AWS and Azure in production environments.
 



 ·       Strong hands\-on with core AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, Lambda, ECS/EKS) and Azure services (VMs, Storage, App Service, AKS, Azure SQL, VNet, Entra ID/Azure AD, Key Vault).
 



 ·       Solid experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for multi\-service, multi\-environment deployments.
 



 ·       Hands\-on with Docker and at least one orchestration platform (Kubernetes, ECS, or AKS).
 



 ·       Proficient with Infrastructure as Code , Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure ARM/Bicep.
 



 ·       Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation and tooling.
 



 ·       Good understanding of networking fundamentals , TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, firewalls, load balancers, and cloud networking constructs (VPC/VNet, subnets, security groups, NSGs).
 



 ·       Working knowledge of Linux system administration and basic Windows server administration.
 



 ·       Experience with monitoring and logging stacks , CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, or Datadog.
 



 ·       Familiarity with cloud security best practices, IAM design, and tools such as AWS Config, GuardDuty, Azure Defender, or equivalent.
 



 ·       Experience coordinating VAPT engagements, supporting ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, and tracking security findings through to remediation.
 



 ·       Comfortable administering common SaaS tools used by the team , Google Workspace / Microsoft 365, Jira, Confluence, GitHub/GitLab, and identity providers (Okta, Entra ID).
 



**Preferred Qualifications** 




 ·       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
 



 ·       Cloud certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer, Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
 



 ·       Experience with message queues and event\-driven architectures (SQS/SNS, Service Bus, Kafka, RabbitMQ).
 



 ·       Exposure to GCP or hybrid/multi\-cloud environments.
 



 ·       Experience supporting regulated or enterprise customers with audit, compliance, and security review requirements.
 



 ·       Interest or experience using GenAI / LLM tools to accelerate DevOps and IT workflows.
 



**What We're Looking For** 




 ·       Strong ownership mindset , treats infrastructure, pipelines, and IT as a product, not a ticket queue.
 



 ·       Broad generalist comfort , happy switching between cloud architecture, pipeline debugging, and helping a teammate fix their laptop on the same day.
 



 ·       Sharp troubleshooting skills across networking, infrastructure, and application layers.
 



 ·       Excellent documentation habits and proactive communication.
 



 ·       Comfortable being the team's first port of call for IT and infrastructure questions.
 



 ·       Bias for automation , prefers writing scripts and IaC over repeating manual work.
