title: AI Engineer
description:
**Summary**
 Guidewire is seeking an AI Engineer to join our Professional Services AI Engineering team in Bangalore. You will work as a dedicated AI\-side member of a Strike Team, pairing with a Product Engineer to deliver AI productization projects end\-to\-end. Your primary craft is harness engineering and prompt engineering — building the agent harnesses, tool integrations, prompts, and eval loops that turn an LLM into a production feature. Around that core, you will also handle the supporting AI work: data parsing, embeddings, RAG pipelines, light ML work, and accuracy validation.
   

  

 You will help shape the technical approach alongside our AI Architect and partner with a Senior AI Engineer on the deeper architectural calls, contributing your own ideas and knowing when to bring in specialist support. This role suits someone who has solid AI fundamentals and is excited to go deep on agent and prompt design as their day job.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Harness Engineering: Build and maintain the LLM harnesses that power each AI feature — agent loops, tool/function calling, context construction, memory, retries, and failure handling. Use frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph where they fit; write custom orchestration where they don't.
* Prompt Engineering: Design, iterate, and version prompts as first\-class assets. Run structured prompt experiments, measure deltas with eval datasets, and keep prompt libraries clean and reviewable.
* RAG Pipelines: Build and operate Retrieval\-Augmented Generation pipelines that extract information from documents and parse it into structured knowledge bases — chunking, indexing, retrieval, reranking, prompt assembly, and response handling — collaborating with the AI Architect to shape and refine the patterns.
* Embeddings \& Vector Indexes: Generate embeddings and manage vector indexes (e.g., OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector). Tune indexes for retrieval quality and cost.
* Data Parsing \& Curation: Build extraction and parsing pipelines for documents, structured records, and customer datasets so they are clean, labeled, and ready for downstream AI work.
* Accuracy Validation: Write and operate accuracy validation scripts. Maintain evaluation datasets and report quality metrics to the Strike Team and the AI Architect.
* Light ML Work: Apply traditional ML where appropriate — classification, clustering, lightweight fine\-tuning — to complement LLM\-based components.
* Analysis: Do the data analysis that informs AI design decisions — sample inspection, error analysis, prompt iteration.


**KPIs \& Success Metrics**
* AI feature accuracy and quality against eval datasets meets the project bar.
* Prompt iteration velocity with measurable eval deltas on owned features.
* RAG and retrieval quality (relevance, groundedness) for owned pipelines.
* On\-time delivery of AI\-side Strike Team commitments.
* Eval coverage: golden and regression sets maintained for owned features.


**Key Skills \& Experience**
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related technical field.
* Experience: 3\+ years of AI or data science experience, with hands\-on time in LLM\-based application development.
* Technical Proficiency:


 – Strong Python skills, including the standard data science stack (pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn).
   

  

 – Hands\-on experience building LLM harnesses — agent loops, tool/function calling, structured outputs — against APIs like Anthropic, OpenAI, or Bedrock.
   

  

 – Strong prompt engineering practice: structured iteration, prompt versioning, and prompt evaluation against datasets.
   

  

 – Working experience with at least one orchestration framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph) and at least one vector database.
   

  

 – Comfortable with embeddings, similarity search, and basic retrieval evaluation.
   

  

 – Working knowledge of classical ML for analysis and lightweight modeling tasks.
   

  

 – Comfort using AI coding assistants (Claude Code) for daily work.
   

  

* Engineering Excellence: Able to write clean, tested code that ships to production — not just notebooks. Familiar with Git, code review, and basic CI/CD.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong instinct for data analysis, error inspection, and iterative experimentation.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience**
* Agent Frameworks: Hands\-on experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents) or custom agent harnesses in production.
* Evals: Experience building structured eval harnesses (golden sets, regression suites, LLM\-as\-judge patterns).
* Cloud: Hands\-on AWS experience (Bedrock, SageMaker, OpenSearch).
* Fine\-Tuning: Any experience with model fine\-tuning or distillation.
* Guidewire Knowledge: Familiarity with Guidewire products or the insurance domain is a plus.
* Domain Analysis: Prior experience working on document\-heavy, regulated, or insurance/finance datasets.


**About Guidewire**
 Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
   

  

 As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.

 Our mission is to build “Unbreakable Systems”—platforms that don’t just survive failures but absorb them, self\-heal, and scale with the business calmly and predictably. We are looking for engineers who want to stop “fixing” and start “architecting” at the highest level.

 We Believe That As a Business Scales, Technology Shouldn’t Become More Fragile. We Have Redesigned Our Entire Engineering Lifecycle To Be AI\-native, Moving Away From Manual Toil Toward a World Of Intelligent, Self\-governing Systems
   

  

* Velocity without Fear (70% AI\-Assisted): We ship fast because we’ve built the safety nets to do so. You won’t just be a “coder”; you will be a system architect. We empower our engineers to use AI for the heavy lifting of development—aiming for 70% of Pull Requests to be AI\-assisted—so you can focus on complex logic and high\-level architecture.
* Built\-in Guardrails \& Self\-Healing Systems: Security and quality aren’t “extra steps”—they are baked into our “Golden Paths.” We build systems that use AI for automated rollbacks and deterministic fallback logic, ensuring the platform absorbs mistakes automatically and remains resilient under pressure.
* Intelligence by Default (Zero\-Toil Operations): We embed AI across the entire lifecycle—Build, Test, Detect, and Operate. By utilizing AI agents to eliminate “Ops Toil,” we’ve created an environment where anomaly detection and incident diagnosis happen in minutes, not hours.
* Predictable Economics \& Growth: We treat cloud costs and system performance as core engineering disciplines. Every engineer at Purplle understands the “unit economics” of their code, ensuring our infrastructure scales as efficiently as our business.


 THE PURPLLE ENGINEER: MINDSET \& IMPACT
   

  

 We Aren’t Looking For “feature Factories”; We Are Looking For Owners Of a Resilient Ecosystem. At Purplle, Your Success Is Defined By Your Mindset And The Tangible Impact You Have On Our Platform
   

  

 The Systems Thinker (Quality \& Resilience): You hate fixing the same bug twice. You’d rather build a “self\-healing” mechanism than perform a manual fix. Your goal is to maintain a Change Failure Rate of \<1\.5% and help us reach a state of fewer than 2 Sev\-1 incidents per quarter.The AI\-Fluent Architect (High Velocity): You are already using AI tools to 10x your own productivity. You leverage these tools to drive a cycle time of \<4 hours and maintain a high frequency of daily deployments, moving code from commit to production with total confidence.

 YOUR SPECIFIC MANDATE

* API \& Service Design Excellence: Build clean, versioned, and backward\-compatible APIs and modular microservices with a strong focus on maintainability, scalability, and clear service contracts.

* Technical Leadership \& Collaboration: Lead design decisions, write clear RFCs, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with Product, Frontend, Data, and DevOps teams to drive high\-quality outcomes.
* Core Engineering Excellence: Apply strong fundamentals in distributed systems, concurrency, and data structures, combined with sharp problem\-solving, debugging, and communication skills.


 TECH STACK

title: Medical Visualization Engineer – 3D Rendering
description:
Key Responsibilities
 * Develop interactive medical visualization applications for 2D images, multiplanar reconstruction, 3D surfaces, and volumetric datasets derived from CT, MR, ultrasound, or fluoroscopy workflows.
* Implement volume rendering, surface rendering, transfer functions, lighting, clipping, cropping, transparency, camera controls, and anatomical exploration features.
* Convert medical image volumes, segmentation masks, landmarks, centerlines, meshes, and quantitative results into accurate and intuitive 3D visual representations.
* Develop visualization features for segmentation overlays, measurements, annotations, registration results, treatment or intervention planning, and image\-guided navigation.
* Implement geometry\-processing workflows including isosurface extraction, mesh generation, smoothing, decimation, repair, normal computation, and model export.
* Optimize rendering pipelines for responsiveness, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and real\-time interaction with large medical datasets.
* Work with DICOM datasets and support image loading, orientation handling, voxel spacing, coordinate transformations, metadata interpretation, and de\-identification\-aware workflows.
* Collaborate with AI and medical imaging teams to visualize model outputs, uncertainty, anatomical structures, and quantitative biomarkers for validation and demonstration.
* Conduct visual and functional testing to verify anatomical correctness, coordinate consistency, rendering quality, usability, and performance across representative datasets.
* Document visualization architecture, rendering methods, design assumptions, performance findings, and user\-interface behavior.


 Required Qualifications
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Graphics, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Medical Imaging, Game Technology, or a related field.
* Less than 3 years of professional, research, internship, or project experience in computer graphics, scientific visualization, medical imaging, game\-engine development, or 3D application development.
* Strong understanding of 3D graphics concepts including coordinate systems, transformations, cameras, lighting, textures, meshes, shaders, depth, transparency, and rendering pipelines.
* Hands\-on programming experience in C\+\+ and/or Python, with exposure to graphics or visualization frameworks.
* Experience with one or more tools or libraries such as VTK, OpenGL, WebGL, Three.js, Unity, Unreal Engine, DirectX, Vulkan, or similar technologies.
* Experience working with 3D geometry, point clouds, surface meshes, volumetric data, or image stacks.
* Familiarity with image\-processing and medical\-imaging tools such as OpenCV, SimpleITK, ITK, pydicom, NiBabel, MONAI, or 3D Slicer.
* Understanding of DICOM image orientation, voxel spacing, patient coordinate systems, resampling, and the relationship between image space and world space.
* Ability to profile and troubleshoot rendering performance, memory use, visual artifacts, and cross\-platform behavior.
* Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with imaging scientists, AI engineers, clinicians, UX designers, and software developers.


 Preferred Skills
 * Experience with direct volume rendering, ray casting, transfer\-function design, GPU shaders, CUDA, compute shaders, or GPU\-accelerated image processing.
* Exposure to medical visualization workflows such as MPR, MIP, MinIP, curved planar reformation, cinematic rendering, segmentation review, surgical planning, or navigation.
* Familiarity with mesh\-processing libraries such as Open3D, PCL, CGAL, trimesh, MeshLab, or similar frameworks.
* Experience creating interactive desktop, web, AR, VR, or mixed\-reality applications for scientific or medical use cases.
* Basic understanding of human factors, visual perception, color mapping, accessibility, and clinical usability considerations.


 Good to have
 * Exposure to front\-end development frameworks such as React, Angular, Qt, Flutter, or similar technologies for building visualization interfaces and proof\-of\-concept demos.
* Experience with DICOMweb, PACS integration concepts, image streaming, cloud\-based rendering, or remote visualization.
* Awareness of regulatory, privacy, cybersecurity, and software\-quality considerations for medical visualization applications, including traceability and reproducible validation.

title: 3D Game Animator
description:
**Project** 





 A VR game built in Unity for standalone headsets. Real\-time character and weapon animation built under strict performance limits.
 




  





**Role** 





 Animate the characters and the weapons. You rig what you animate, you export it, and you hook it up in Unity yourself. You own your assets from brief to in\-game, working autonomously.
 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Animate characters: idles, locomotion cycles, combat, reactions.
* Animate weapons and props: fire, reload, equip / holster, moving parts, attachment to hands and sockets.
* Rig and skin your own characters and weapons in Blender — joint placement, weighting, animation controls.
* Build and maintain Animator state machines — states, transitions, parameters, blend trees, layers, avatar masks.
* Set up avatars, retargeting, and root motion.
* Export FBX from Blender and integrate in Unity; diagnose and fix import issues yourself.
* Keep bone counts, clip lengths, and rig complexity inside the project’s performance budget.
* Deliver clean, named, reusable animation assets the rest of the team can pick up.
* Work with 3D, Design, and Dev on animation hookup and game feel.



  





**Required** 



* **Hand\-keyed animation** 

 — character and weapon animation of a quality we can ship. Clean timing, weight, arcs, and silhouette.
* **Rigging and skinning in Blender** 

 — you build your own rigs and paint your own weights, ready for game use.
* **Unity Animator** 

 — state machines, transitions, parameters, blend trees, layers. You wire it up, not someone else.
* **Autonomous** 

 — you take a brief, make your own calls, unblock yourself, and deliver without close supervision.
* FBX pipeline Blender → Unity — scale, axis, normals, avatar setup, import settings.
* Comfortable working in a current Unity 6 project.
* Mid\-level minimum — at least one full production cycle of animation work behind you.
* A portfolio or reel showing animation and rigs you made yourself.
* English, written and spoken.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Shipped VR or mobile title.
* VR\-specific animation — first\-person arms, hand poses, IK\-driven avatars.
* Unity Animation Rigging package and runtime IK setups.
* C\# scripting for animation hookup and animation events.
* Facial rigging and blendshapes.
* Rig tooling / Python scripting in Blender.
* Motion capture cleanup.



  





**Hiring process** 



1. Portfolio / reel review.
2. Take\-home technical test (approx. 4 h) — rig, skin, and animate a supplied character, then set it up in a Unity state machine.
3. Live follow\-up — you walk us through your rig and your setup.



  





**How to apply** 





 Send your resume, portfolio, and a short note on why you're the right fit to
 
**talent@jmancurly.com** 

 . We want to see your best work. And we move fast.

title: Medical Imaging Engineer II
description:
**About the Company** 




 ImmersiveTouch is a medical device company transforming surgical planning through virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and precision 3D printing technologies. Our platform enables surgeons to visualize, plan, and rehearse complex procedures using patient specific anatomy and immersive technologies. We develop Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), anatomical models, and surgical planning solutions used across leading healthcare institutions.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 ImmersiveTouch is seeking a
 **Medical Imaging Engineer II** 
 to support the development of patient\-specific surgical planning solutions, 3D renderings, and visualization assets for clinical use. The Medical Imaging Engineer II is responsible for converting medical imaging data into clinically useful digital outputs for surgical planning and visualization. This includes segmentation of CT data, generation of 3D models, preparation of VR\-ready files, and creation of pre\-planning files for workflows such as orthognathic surgery. The role requires a strong understanding of anatomy, imaging quality, and technical execution, along with the ability to manage multiple active cases with consistency and attention to detail.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Perform segmentation and 3D reconstruction of DICOM datasets, with emphasis on CMF and thoracic anatomy.
* Create patient\-specific 3D renderings for surgical planning, visualization, and simulation.
* Generate VR\-ready files for immersive visualization workflows.
* Prepare pre\-operative planning files, planning reports and measurements analysis reports.
* Review incoming imaging data for completeness, quality, and suitability for case production.
* Validate segmentation accuracy, anatomical detail, and final deliverables.
* Assist in preparation of final case reports and supporting clinical documentation.
* Maintain detailed records of case status, workflow steps, technical notes, and deliverables.
* Identify case\-specific issues and escalate complex clinical or technical concerns appropriately.
* Support continuous improvement of segmentation workflows, documentation standards, and quality processes.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Strong understanding of cross\-sectional anatomy and medical imaging interpretation.
* Hands\-on experience with medical image segmentation, 3D modeling, and anatomical reconstruction, using software such as Mimics or 3D Slicer.
* Ability to work effectively with DICOM datasets.
* Experience preparing technical outputs for surgical planning or advanced medical visualization.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines in a case\-driven environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to learn new software tools, workflows, and technologies independently.
* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, quality, and patient data confidentiality.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Imaging, Radiologic Sciences, or a related technical or clinical field.
* 2–5 years of experience in medical imaging, segmentation, 3D modeling, or surgical planning support.
* Experience with CMF, thoracic, or orthognathic planning workflows.
* Proficiency with segmentation and visualization software such as Materialise Mimics, Dolphin Imaging, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to VR/AR applications, digital surgical planning, or pre\-operative simulation workflows.



  





**Success Profile** 




 Success in this role requires strong technical execution, dependable case ownership, and the ability to produce accurate outputs with limited day\-to\-day oversight. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating as an individual contributor, can work through moderately complex cases independently, and communicates clearly when coordination or escalation is needed.

**Junior C\+\+ Engineer**
 Harmonic is the worldwide leader in virtualized broadband solutions, shaping the next generation of multigigabit connectivity. We revolutionized broadband networking via the industry’s first virtualized broadband solution, enabling broadband operators to deploy gigabit internet service more flexibly to consumers’ homes and mobile devices.
   

  

 Learn more at
 **www.harmonicinc.com** 
 .
   

  

**Role Description**
 We are looking for a Junior C\+\+ Engineer to join our team
   

  

 You will report to the Director of Core Software, Broadband business unit
   

  

 You will be based in Bengaluru, India
   

  

**Location**
 Hybrid work with at least 3 times a week from the office in Bengaluru.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
 As a member of one of our global Agile SW Scrum teams, you will contribute to the development of cutting\-edge, cable industry\-leading products and services.
   

  

**Your Work Will Involve**
* C/C\+\+ Software Development: Design and implement features within the MAC and upper layer protocol domains, leveraging the latest advancements in C\+\+ technology.
* Advanced Networking Solutions: Contribute to solutions running on Linux servers using containerized environments (Kubernetes), employing state\-of\-the\-art technologies and methodologies.
* Troubleshooting \& Debugging: Investigate and resolve complex issues from internal QA teams and external customer reports.
* Agile Methodologies: Plan, develop, and deliver features in an Agile development environment.


**What You Should Have**
* B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* 1\-3 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining software applications using C\+\+.
* Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ programming, with a focus on developing robust, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Solid experience in multi\-threading, object\-oriented design (OOD), and leveraging design patterns to solve complex problems.
* Comprehensive understanding of networking concepts and environments, with hands\-on experience in developing and debugging networking\-related applications.
* Proven experience developing under Linux operating systems, including expertise in debugging and performance optimization in Linux environments.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex, system\-wide issues, drive the development of high\-complexity features in C\+\+, and lead the design of multi\-module, multi\-package solutions with a strong system\-wide perspective.
* Experience with Python for scripting, automation, or supplementary feature development.
* Familiarity with DOCSIS concepts and implementations – advantage
* AI enthusiast with a strong interest in incorporating AI tools and technologies into software development processes to improve productivity, quality, and delivery speed.


 At Harmonic, we believe that building and nurturing a global team with diverse backgrounds and voices is critical to our success. Together, we achieve excellence through creativity and innovation, build relationships based on integrity and mutual respect, and deliver the highest quality in every aspect of our business for the benefit of our employees, business partners and shareholders.
   

  

**About Us**
 Harmonic (NASDAQ: HLIT), the worldwide leader in virtualized broadband solutions, is transforming multi\-gigabit connectivity. The company’s industry\-leading cOS™ virtualized broadband platform, suite of solutions for fiber and DOCSIS, and a growing portfolio of AI\-powered network intelligence solutions, enable broadband service providers to simplify operations, deliver exceptional subscriber experiences and expand revenue streams. With thousands of vCMTS servers and hundreds of thousands of RPDs deployed globally, Harmonic powers next\-generation broadband services with five\-nines reliability. Anchored with a customer\-first approach and driven by a legacy of innovation, Harmonic supports broadband service providers at every stage of their network evolution. More information is available at www.harmonicinc.com.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Join the broadband revolution at Harmonic, where we're pioneering the future of multigigabit connectivity! As the worldwide leader in virtualized broadband solutions, we're transforming the way people live, work, and connect. Our groundbreaking technologies, including Unified DOCSIS 4\.0, Remote OLT, and AI\-Ops solutions, are empowering operators to deliver lightning\-fast internet services to homes and businesses across the globe. With our industry\-first virtualized broadband solution and cOS platform, we're simplifying operations, reducing costs, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. We're proud to power next\-gen broadband services for leading operators across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia.
   

  

 At Harmonic, you'll be part of a dynamic team that's shaping the future of connectivity. You'll have the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge projects, collaborate with top talent, and be part of a company that's making a real impact.
   

  

 Join our mission to empower a more connected world and discover a career that's fast, innovative, and full of possibilities!

Good to Have; \- Exposure to electronic hardware design / schematics. \- Experience with firmware architecture \& optimization. \- Prior work with industrial communication protocols (CAN, RS485\). title: Robotics & Mechatronics Design Engineer
description:
**Robotics \& Mechatronics Design Engineer** 




  





**Company:** 
 DSI Robotics
 



**Location:** 
 Noida, India
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time, On\-site
 



**Domain:** 
 Confined\-Space Robotics, Mobile Robotics, ROVs, Industrial Robotics
   





**Company Description :** 




 DSI Robotics is an R\&D\-focused engineering company specializing in confined\-space robotics. Established in 2006, we are among the earliest companies in India working in applied mobile robotics, with two decades of experience in building safety\-critical robotic solutions for industrial applications.
 



 We design and develop bespoke robotic systems across inspection\-class and work\-class ROV domains for sectors such as Water, Wastewater, Marine, Thermal Power, Hydel Power, Oil \& Gas, and other industrial environments where human entry is hazardous, difficult, or impractical.
 



 Our robots are used for pipeline inspection, sewer and manhole inspection, underwater inspection and cleaning, desilting, dredging, tank cleaning, oily sludge handling, and other specialized industrial tasks.
 



 DSI began as a bootstrapped bedroom startup, funded by the founders using the remainder of their scholarship money to pursue their dream of building robots at a time when the word “robotics” itself was often met with skepticism by customers. That journey shaped our culture: practical, frugal, deeply technical, and focused on building machines that solve real industrial problems.
 



  





**Role Description :** 




 We are looking for a
 **Robotics \& Mechatronics Design Engineer** 
 to join our engineering team in Noida.
 



 This is a hands\-on role involving the design and development of robotic and mechatronic systems for confined\-space and industrial applications. The engineer will work on mechanical design, mechatronics architecture, actuator selection, sensor integration, control system planning, prototype development, testing, troubleshooting, and iterative improvement of robotic platforms.
 



 This is not a routine catalogue\-design role. At DSI, every project brings a different engineering challenge, and the candidate must be comfortable working on new concepts, practical constraints, field feedback, and real\-world failures.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 



* Design robotic and mechatronic systems for confined\-space and industrial applications.
* Create CAD models, mechanical assemblies, detailed drawings, and design documentation.
* Select motors, actuators, gearboxes, bearings, seals, sensors, materials, and mechanical components.
* Perform engineering calculations related to torque, load, speed, stability, buoyancy, sealing, strength, and system performance.
* Work with electronics, firmware, software, and manufacturing teams to develop complete robotic systems.
* Support prototype fabrication, assembly, testing, validation, and field trials.
* Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, control, and system\-level design issues.
* Improve designs based on test results, field feedback, manufacturability, reliability, and cost.
* Contribute to R\&D for new robotic platforms, mechanisms, mobility systems, and automation solutions.



  





**Candidate Profile :** 




 We are looking for an engineer with a strong analytical foundation, sound engineering judgement, and a genuine passion for building real\-world robotic systems.
 



 A
 **B.Tech / M.Tech degree** 
 in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Robotics, Electronics, Electrical, Control Systems, or a related engineering discipline from a premier institute such as an
 **IIT, NIT, IIIT, BITS** 
 , or another reputed engineering institution will be preferred.
 



 That said, institute name alone is not the deciding factor. What matters most is the candidate’s ability to think scientifically, reason from first principles, justify design decisions mathematically, and convert engineering ideas into practical working systems.
 



 Exceptional candidates from other institutes with strong fundamentals, proven project work, and demonstrable technical depth are equally encouraged to apply.
 



 Candidates with 2\-4 yrs (or more) of relevant industrial experience will be preferred. However freshers with sound project experience may also apply.
 



  





**The Ideal Candidate Should Have :** 



* Strong foundation in mathematics, physics, mechanics, and core engineering fundamentals.
* Exposure to mechatronics, electronics, embedded systems, sensors, control systems, and AI/ML applications in robotics.
* Ability to scientifically justify design choices instead of relying only on trial\-and\-error.
* Interest in robotics competitions, technical clubs, hackathons, SAE BAJA, Formula Student, RoboCon, e\-Yantra, Smart India Hackathon, or similar hands\-on engineering activities.
* Genuine love for tinkering, prototyping, experimenting, debugging, and building machines beyond classroom requirements.
* Ability to participate in detailed technical discussions, design reviews, brainstorming sessions, and collaborative problem solving.
* Ability to balance creativity with engineering discipline, reliability, manufacturability, maintainability, cost, and field practicality.
* Excitement for designing robots that work in harsh industrial environments such as sewers, tanks, pipelines, underwater systems, confined spaces, and oil \& gas facilities.



  





**Preferred Portfolio :** 




 Candidates are encouraged to share examples of hands\-on technical work, such as robotics projects, competition robots, CAD models, mechanism designs, prototypes, control systems, sensor integration projects, or personal tinkering projects.
 



 We are especially interested in candidates who can clearly explain what they personally designed, what failed, how they debugged it, and what they learned.
 



  





**Why Join DSI Robotics?** 




 At DSI Robotics, you will not be designing decorative robots for controlled lab demonstrations. You will work on rugged machines that must survive sewers, pipelines, tanks, underwater environments, sludge\-filled spaces, and industrial sites where reliability matters.
 



 Robotics is an attractive field today, but enthusiasm alone is not enough. We are looking for engineers who can support their ideas with sound reasoning, calculations, experiments, prototypes, and practical validation.
 



 If you love robotics, enjoy technical depth, like to tinker, and want to build machines that solve difficult real\-world industrial problems, we would love to hear from you.

title: JUNIOR CAD ENGINEER
description:
**Job Summary:** 




  





**Enigmasoft Technologies is seeking a Junior CAD Engineer to support rapid design development, mechanical modelling and prototype fabrication within its Research \& Development engineering team.** 




**The selected candidate will create and revise 3D parts and assemblies, prepare manufacturing drawings and bills of materials, and convert engineering concepts into practical components for prototyping and testing. The role will support multidisciplinary projects in renewable energy, clean technology and advanced engineering, including solar photovoltaic systems, Organic Rankine Cycle systems and carbon\-capture technologies.** 




**This position is suited to a technically curious engineer who enjoys hands\-on problem\-solving, iterative design and working closely with engineers, technicians and fabrication vendors to improve designs through testing and real\-world feedback.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**CAD Modelling and Assembly Design** 




**•** 
 Create, modify and optimise accurate 3D CAD models of mechanical parts, assemblies, fixtures and prototype systems.
 



**•** 
 Translate sketches, engineering concepts, dimensions and functional requirements into structured CAD models.
 



**•** 
 Develop parametric models that can be updated efficiently during rapid design iterations.
 



**•** 
 Build and review assemblies for fit, alignment, interference, accessibility and basic serviceability.
 



**•** 
 Support senior engineers in converting early\-stage concepts into practical and manufacturable components.
 



  





 Drawings, BOMs and Manufacturing Documentation
 



**•** 
 Prepare clear 2D part drawings and assembly drawings with dimensions, tolerances, material specifications and manufacturing notes.
 



**•** 
 Create and maintain basic bills of materials (BOMs), part lists and component identification records.
 



**•** 
 Apply appropriate drawing standards, units, revision details and document\-control practices.
 



**•** 
 Update drawings and supporting documentation whenever a design is revised following review, fabrication or testing.
 



  





 Rapid Prototyping and Fabrication Support
 



**•** 
 Prepare CAD files for 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, sheet\-metal fabrication, moulding and other prototype\-manufacturing processes.
 



**•** 
 Review model orientation, wall thickness, clearances, tolerances and other design\-for\-manufacturing considerations before releasing files.
 



**•** 
 Coordinate with internal fabrication personnel and external vendors to clarify drawings, dimensions, materials and manufacturing requirements.
 



**•** 
 Inspect fabricated parts for basic dimensional accuracy, fitment and conformity with approved drawings.
 



**•** 
 Assist in resolving fitment, assembly or manufacturability issues identified during fabrication and prototype build activities.
 



  





 Design Iteration, Testing and Review
 



**•** 
 Incorporate feedback from testing, design reviews, prototype assembly and field observations into updated CAD models.
 



**•** 
 Participate in design reviews and clearly present model changes, constraints, assumptions and open issues.
 



**•** 
 Support prototype assembly and testing to understand how design decisions perform under practical conditions.
 



**•** 
 Document design changes, iteration history, lessons learned and pending improvements.
 



  





 CAD Data Management and Coordination
 



**•** 
 Maintain organised CAD libraries, folder structures, file\-naming conventions and revision histories.
 



**•** 
 Ensure released files are clearly identified and prevent outdated models or drawings from being used for fabrication.
 



**•** 
 Coordinate with mechanical, electronics, testing and procurement teams to obtain the information required for model development.
 



**•** 
 Manage multiple modelling and drawing tasks while meeting agreed priorities and timelines.
 



**•** 
 Perform other related engineering and prototype\-development duties as assigned.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 




**1\.** 
 BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Design or a closely related discipline.
 



**2\.** 
 Zero to four years of experience in mechanical design, CAD modelling, product development, rapid prototyping or a related engineering role.
 



**3\.** 
 Fresh graduates with strong CAD fundamentals, relevant academic projects, internships, competition experience or a practical portfolio are encouraged to apply.
 



**4\.** 
 A portfolio or examples of CAD models, drawings, fabricated prototypes, hobby projects or personal engineering work will be an advantage.
 



 Key Skills and Competencies
 



**•** 
 Strong proficiency in 3D CAD modelling, parametric design and assembly development.
 



**•** 
 Hands\-on experience with Fusion 360 is preferred; SolidWorks or an equivalent professional CAD platform is also acceptable.
 



**•** 
 Good understanding of mechanical fundamentals, engineering dimensions, fits, clearances and tolerances.
 



**•** 
 Ability to create detailed part drawings and basic manufacturing\-ready documentation.
 



**•** 
 Familiarity with rapid\-prototyping processes such as 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, sheet\-metal fabrication or moulding.
 



**•** 
 Awareness of basic design\-for\-manufacturing and design\-for\-assembly principles.
 



**•** 
 Strong attention to detail, structured file management and revision\-control discipline.
 



**•** 
 Ability to work independently, accept technical feedback and manage multiple design iterations under tight timelines.
 



**•** 
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office or equivalent engineering documentation tools.
 



**•** 
 Clear communication and coordination with engineers, technicians and fabrication vendors.
 



  





 Technical Aptitude and Candidate Profile
 



 The ideal candidate should demonstrate a genuine interest in engineering, testing, fabrication and problem\-solving. The role is highly practical and requires a willingness to learn from prototype failures, manufacturing constraints and repeated testing cycles.
 



**•** 
 Strong foundational understanding of mechanics, materials, manufacturing processes and engineering physics relevant to mechanical design.
 



**•** 
 Ability to apply theoretical knowledge to real\-world design, fitment and prototype\-development challenges.
 



**•** 
 Practical hobbies, technical interests, engineering competitions, personal builds or experimentation experience will be preferred.
 



**•** 
 Curiosity to understand how components are manufactured, assembled, tested and improved.
 



**•** 
 A proactive, detail\-oriented and self\-motivated approach to work.
 



**•** 
 Adaptability and resilience in a fast\-moving R\&D environment where requirements may evolve during testing.
 



**•** 
 Collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute beyond narrowly defined modelling tasks when required.
 



  





**ROLE CLARIFICATION** 
 This is a junior engineering role with a strong focus on hands\-on CAD development and prototype support. Candidates are not expected to independently own complex engineering systems from the first day, but they should demonstrate sound fundamentals, curiosity, discipline and the ability to develop rapidly under technical guidance.
 



 About Enigmasoft Technologies
 



 Enigmasoft Technologies is a rapidly expanding, R\&D\-driven company specialising in advanced IT and engineering solutions. We develop hardware and software technologies across clean energy, advanced manufacturing and digital systems, with a strong focus on early\-stage innovation, rapid prototyping and technology commercialisation.
 



 Our engineering work includes renewable\-energy and climate\-technology products such as solar photovoltaic systems, Organic Rankine Cycle systems and carbon\-capture solutions. By combining mechanical engineering, electronics, software and applied research, we develop technologies that bridge laboratory concepts and real\-world deployment.
 



  





**Additional Candidate Requirements:** 




  






 Candidates applying for this role must demonstrate a genuine passion for engineering, testing, and problem\-solving.
 




  






 Preference will be given to individuals who possess practical hobby skills, hands\-on technical interests, or personal projects related to engineering, innovation, and experimentation.
 




  






 As this position is within Research \& Development (R\&D) Engineering, candidates should be comfortable working in a highly practical, testing\-driven environment that requires analytical thinking and continuous experimentation.
 




  






 Applicants must also have a strong foundational understanding of physics relevant to their area of expertise, whether in electronics, mechanical systems, fluid dynamics, or related engineering disciplines. A problem\-solving mindset and the ability to apply theoretical knowledge to real\-world testing and development are essential for this role.
 




  





  





**Why Join Team Enigma** 




**•** 
 Gain hands\-on exposure to real engineering challenges, rapid innovation cycles and multidisciplinary R\&D projects.
 



**•** 
 Work directly on CAD models and prototypes that progress from concept through fabrication, testing and improvement.
 



**•** 
 Develop technical depth across design, manufacturing, materials, testing and product\-development processes.
 



**•** 
 Take ownership, learn from experienced engineers and contribute beyond conventional role boundaries.
 



**•** 
 Build practical experience in clean\-energy and climate\-technology development.
 



  





**Employee Benefits** 




**Insurance** 
 Medical insurance for self, spouse and children, plus accidental insurance.
 **Leave** 
 Maternity, paternity, bereavement, marriage, sick, casual, floater and privilege leave.
 **Retirement** 
 Provident Fund contribution and leave encashment.
 **Well\-being** 
 Paid sick time, paid time off and a supportive work environment.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** 
**Senior** 
**Mechanical Engineer**
**Job Description**
 The Senior Engineer serves as the technical lead for the design and development of wafer handling robots and automation equipment. This role focuses on end\-to\-end product design and detailing, from concept through verification and support for manufacturing and testing, ensuring robust, precise, and cost\-effective mechanical solutions for semiconductor equipment and advanced automation systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the mechanical design of wafer handling robots and automation equipment, serving as the technical authority for key design decisions.
* Create detailed 3D CAD models, assemblies, and engineering drawings using SolidWorks for complex mechanical systems.
* Design precision mechanical parts and assemblies, including robot arms, motion mechanisms, wafer grippers, and end\-effectors.
* Perform tolerance analysis and tolerance stack\-up to ensure proper fit, function, and reliability of mechanical assemblies.
* Conduct engineering calculations and component sizing to validate design performance and ensure compliance with functional requirements.
* Perform structural and modal analysis using ANSYS to assess mechanical integrity, stiffness, and dynamic behavior of components and assemblies.
* Troubleshoot mechanical design issues, identify root causes, and recommend effective design improvements and corrective actions.
* Select and integrate servo motors, linear actuators, gearboxes, bearings, ball screws, harmonic drives, pneumatic systems, and vacuum systems into robotic and automation solutions.
* Apply GD\&T and best practices in engineering drawings to clearly define dimensional and geometric requirements.
* Utilize DFX principles (including design for manufacturability and design for excellence) to improve product quality, reliability, and ease of production.
* Support prototype development and production builds by collaborating closely with manufacturing teams and providing technical guidance.
* Work with suppliers to develop, qualify, and refine components, ensuring they meet design specifications and performance targets.
* Improve existing designs for manufacturability, quality, and cost, driving continuous improvement across products and processes.
* Prepare bills of materials (BOMs), specifications, and comprehensive technical documentation to support production, testing, and lifecycle management.
* Participate in customer and internal design reviews, presenting design concepts, analysis results, and risk assessments.
* Support product testing, evaluation, and validation activities to confirm that designs meet performance, reliability, and safety requirements.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, suppliers, and customers in design reviews and qualification activities.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a structured approach to troubleshooting complex mechanical and motion\-related issues.

title: Algorithm Developer - ADAS
description:
**Business Unit:** 
 EPS Mobility
   

  

**Role:** 
 Algorithm Developer \- ADAS
   

  

 The Algorithm Developer – ADAS is responsible for developing, optimizing, and validating ADAS algorithms for embedded real\-time controllers used in automotive (e.g., lane change assist, adaptive cruise control etc.). You will lead the development of ADAS algorithms, ensuring high\-performance, safety\-compliant, and scalable solutions for traction and auxiliary motor systems.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define and develop the end\-to\-end algorithmic architecture for ADAS functions such as Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Lane Keeping Assist (LKA), Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) etc.
* Decompose system\-level ADAS functions into modular algorithm components: perception, fusion, prediction, planning and control.
* Design sensor fusion frameworks (camera, radar, ultrasonic, IMU, GNSS) for accurate environment modeling and object tracking.
* Architect algorithms for multi\-sensor object detection, classification, and tracking, leveraging both traditional signal processing and AI/ML methods.
* Define the software and hardware architecture interfaces to support real\-time execution of algorithms on ECUs, GPUs, and embedded processors.
* Optimize algorithms for embedded performance, latency, and memory efficiency while maintaining high accuracy.
* Collaborate with system architects, software engineers, and data scientists to ensure seamless integration and deployment.
* Conduct algorithm performance evaluations using simulation, SIL/HIL, and on\-vehicle validation.
* Contribute to functional safety (ISO 26262\) and SOTIF (ISO 21448\) compliance from an algorithmic perspective.
* Maintain awareness of latest research and technologies in ADAS, perception, and AI for automotive applications.
* Mentor and guide algorithm engineers in technical design, modeling, and validation best practices.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelors or Master’s in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Robotics or related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in ADAS / Autonomous Driving algorithm development or similar domains.
* Deep understanding of sensor processing, computer vision, sensor fusion, path planning, and vehicle control algorithms.
* Strong experience with C/C\+\+, Python, and MATLAB/Simulink for algorithm design and validation.
* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and embedded AI deployment (CNN \& latest technologies).
* Experience with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) and AUTOSAR Classic/Adaptive environments.
* Solid understanding of vehicle dynamics, control theory, and state estimation techniques (Kalman Filters, Particle Filters, etc.).
* Experience with HIL/SIL validation, simulation tools (e.g. CarMaker) and data replay systems.

title: Senior Hardware Engineer
description:
**About us:** 
  Kosha Labs builds multimodal data infrastructure for physical AI across stereo vision, tactile sensing, motion capture, and robotics. We work with leading robotics companies and frontier AI labs and are backed by top Silicon Valley investors.
 



  





**Role:** 
  We're looking for a strong hardware engineer to build and own our multimodal capture systems.
 



  




1. **Tactile sensing:** 
  Integrate high\-resolution tactile glove systems with head\-mounted and wrist\-mounted RGB/depth cameras. Own end\-to\-end hardware synchronization (hardware trigger lines, PTP/clock discipline), precise timestamping pipelines, sensor calibration (intrinsic/extrinsic where applicable), tactile sensor characterization (pressure response curves, latency profiling, noise modeling), and system\-level validation across multi\-sensor streams.
2. **Stereo vision:** 
  Design and deploy synchronized multi\-camera rigs for head and wrist viewpoints. Own hardware triggering architecture, system\-wide clock synchronization (PTP/IEEE\-1588 or equivalent), camera intrinsics/extrinsics calibration, stereo rectification, IMU\-camera extrinsic calibration, rolling\-shutter compensation (if applicable), and full pipeline validation including reprojection error analysis and temporal alignment checks.
3. **Motion capture:** 
  Integrate full\-body IMU\-based motion capture systems with vision and tactile modalities. Own global coordinate frame definition and alignment across modalities, sensor\-to\-body kinematic calibration (joint offsets, segment alignment), time synchronization across IMU and vision streams, drift estimation and correction, and validation of pose consistency across multi\-sensor fusion pipelines.



  





**You'll enjoy this role if:** 
  You like building hardware, debugging sensors, and solving hard problems across electronics, embedded systems, and robotics. You want to build systems that leave the lab and collect data at scale.

description:
**About The Role**
 Kuku is India's one of the largest content platforms. This role owns the Engagement charter at Kuku — the cross\-functional function responsible for how often people come back, how deep they go, and how the product turns a first listen into a daily habit. You'll run the POD's roadmap end to end: dig into user behaviour, decide what to build next, and ship features that move engagement and retention. It's a role for someone who is equally comfortable in a cohort chart and in a prototype, and who can turn a hunch into something clickable before writing a single line of spec.
   

  

**What You'll Work OnOwn The Engagement POD**
* Own the engagement roadmap end to end — set the direction for the POD, decide what gets built, and drive it from idea to launch to iteration.
* Run the POD's day\-to\-day: define and prioritise the backlog, keep engineering and design unblocked, and make the calls that keep the squad moving.
* Own engagement and retention metrics for the POD, and be accountable for the number, not just the shipping.


**User Analysis \& Insight**
* Do the user analysis yourself — cohort, funnel, and retention analysis to understand where people drop off and why they come back.
* Combine quantitative data with qualitative research (user interviews, session reviews, feedback) to build a real picture of listener behaviour.
* Turn insight into a clear, prioritised view of what to build next.


**Feature Planning \& Prototyping**
* Plan new features from problem to spec — define the opportunity, size it, write crisp requirements, and align the POD around them.
* Vibe code your ideas. Use AI\-assisted coding and prototyping tools to build quick, working prototypes and clickable demos, so ideas get validated with real interaction before they hit the roadmap.
* Design and run experiments (A/B tests) to validate whether a feature actually moves the needle.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with engineering, design, data, and content to ship features that land.
* Communicate what you're building and why, and keep stakeholders aligned on outcomes over output.


**What We're Looking For**
* 3–6 years in product management, ideally on consumer products at real scale.
* Genuinely data\-driven — comfortable with product analytics, cohort and funnel analysis, and pulling your own numbers (SQL or tools like Amplitude / Mixpanel).
* Strong user\-research instinct — you talk to users and let evidence, not opinion, drive the roadmap.
* Vibe coding ability — you can use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, v0, or similar) to build prototypes and validate ideas hands\-on, without waiting on engineering.
* A track record of planning and shipping features that measurably improved engagement or retention.
* Clear thinking and clear communication — you can turn ambiguity into a plan the POD can execute.


**Good to have**
* Experience specifically on engagement, retention, growth, or habit\-formation problems.
* Experience with subscription, content, audio, or OTT products.
* Familiarity with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing at scale.
* Comfort working across the funnel — onboarding, activation, and re\-engagement.


**Preferred Tools \& Technologies**
* Analytics: SQL, ClickHouse
* Prototyping / Vibe coding: Claude, Cursor, v0, Figma
* Experimentation: A/B testing and feature\-flag tooling


**Education**
* Bachelor's or Master's in any discipline — or equivalent practical experience. What matters is judgement, curiosity, and a bias for shipping.


**What We Offer**
* Full ownership of a POD that directly moves the numbers that matter.
* Competitive comp \+ ESOPs.
* Learning budget and certification support.
* A team that cares about outcomes, not just output.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a “Scrum Master” at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job\-specific skillsets.
   

  

 To be successful as a “Scrum Master”, you should have experience with:
   

  

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**
* Actively identify and resolve blockers to maintain team momentum and delivery schedule.
* Expert in Agile Practices and methodologies and help teams to adopt them
* Foster Collaboration, Build trust, encourage transparency, and promote shared problem\-solving.
* Monitor Performance. Track metrics like velocity and burndown charts to guide improvements.
* Enable Tooling, Support automation, and reporting tools to streamline workflows.
* Practice empathy, stewardship, and community building.


**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities.
* Ability to mentor and guide junior team members.
* Collaborative mindset with a focus on team success.


 This role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 With hyperscale data centre campuses in Navi Mumbai and Greater Noida (Delhi NCR), advanced GPU\-powered AI infrastructure, and a comprehensive ecosystem of cloud, AI, hosting, cybersecurity, and managed platform services, Yotta delivers high\-performance, scalable, and compliant digital infrastructure built for the AI era.
 



  





 Yotta is at the forefront of powering India’s sovereign AI and digital transformation journey through world\-class infrastructure, deep technology partnerships, and fully India\-hosted enterprise\-grade platforms.
 



  





**Job Scope:** 




 Yotta is building next\-generation AI\-powered products, including no\-code AI builders, enterprise SaaS platforms, intelligent workflow systems, and data\-intensive applications.
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced Product Designer who can transform complex business and technology workflows into intuitive, effective, and scalable product experiences. You will own design initiatives from problem discovery through delivery—working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders.
 



  





 This role requires a balance of user empathy, product thinking, interaction design, visual craft, and commercial awareness. You will help shape product direction, improve design quality, and ensure that design decisions contribute to meaningful user and business outcomes.
 



  





**Total /Relevant Experience:** 



* 5\+ years of experience



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**A. Product Discovery and Strategy** 



* Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to understand product goals, customer needs, operational constraints, and success metrics.
* Participate in product discovery through stakeholder interviews, user research, competitive analysis, workshops, and data review.
* Frame ambiguous problems, identify user pain points, and translate insights into clear design opportunities.
* Contribute to product strategy, roadmap discussions, feature prioritisation, and experience principles.
* Define hypotheses and success measures for major design initiatives.
* Advocate for users while balancing business priorities, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.



**B. End\-to\-End Product Design** 



* Own the complete design process for assigned products and features, from discovery and concept development through implementation and iteration.
* Create information architectures, journey maps, personas, task flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity interfaces.
* Design complex experiences such as dashboards, workflow builders, configuration tools, editors, administrative systems, and AI\-assisted interactions.
* Simplify technical and data\-heavy workflows without reducing necessary functionality.
* Account for complete product behaviour, including loading, empty, success, validation, permission, error, and edge\-case states.
* Design responsive experiences across relevant devices and screen sizes.
* Validate concepts early and refine solutions using research, feedback, and product data.



**C. Interaction and Visual Design** 



* Produce polished, implementation\-ready interfaces with strong attention to hierarchy, typography, spacing, colour, and content.
* Define clear interaction patterns for navigation, forms, tables, search, filtering, data visualisation, drag\-and\-drop experiences, and conversational interfaces.
* Create interactive prototypes to communicate behaviour, validate ideas, and align stakeholders.
* Apply accessibility and inclusive\-design principles throughout the design process.
* Maintain a high standard of consistency and craft across products.



**D. AI and Emerging Product Experiences** 



* Design transparent, usable, and trustworthy experiences for AI\-powered products.
* Create interaction patterns for prompting, model configuration, AI\-generated output, review and approval, feedback, and human oversight.
* Consider uncertainty, explainability, user control, data privacy, and failure recovery when designing AI interactions.
* Explore new interaction models while ensuring that experiences remain understandable and valuable to users.



**E. Design Systems and Scalability** 



* Use and actively contribute to Yotta’s shared design system and Figma component libraries.
* Identify reusable patterns and propose new components, variants, guidelines, and interaction standards.
* Work with Engineering to ensure components are feasible, accessible, and implemented consistently.
* Help improve design\-system governance, documentation, adoption, and quality.
* Reduce design and implementation inconsistencies across products.



**F. Research, Validation, and Optimisation** 



* Plan or support user interviews, concept validation, usability testing, heuristic evaluations, and product reviews.
* Convert qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable design improvements.
* Use product analytics, customer feedback, support insights, and usability findings to evaluate shipped experiences.
* Iterate based on evidence and track whether design changes improve defined outcomes.
* Present research findings and design recommendations clearly to product teams and leadership.



**G. Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Delivery** 



* Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Facilitate design workshops, critiques, and decision\-making sessions.
* Present design rationale clearly and build alignment among technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Provide developers with clear specifications, prototypes, annotations, assets, and interaction guidance.
* Review implemented experiences and work with Engineering to resolve quality gaps before release.
* Represent design during sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and product demonstrations.



**H. Design Leadership** 



* Raise the quality of product thinking and design execution across the team.
* Provide thoughtful feedback during design critiques and product reviews.
* Mentor less\-experienced designers and support their professional development.
* Help improve design processes, collaboration practices, tools, and documentation.
* Communicate risks, trade\-offs, and recommendations with confidence and clarity.
* Encourage a culture of customer focus, experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.



**Must\-have skill** 



* 5\+ years of professional product design experience, preferably working on SaaS, enterprise, B2B, AI, cloud, or data\-intensive products.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating end\-to\-end product design, structured problem\-solving, systems thinking, and measurable product impact.
* Demonstrated experience taking complex features or products from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Strong command of interaction design, information architecture, user flows, prototyping, and visual design.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto layout, variables, prototyping, and design libraries.
* Experience designing responsive web applications and complex desktop workflows.
* Strong understanding of usability principles, accessibility standards, and inclusive design.
* Experience collaborating with Product Managers and Engineers in agile product teams.
* Ability to interpret customer feedback, research findings, business requirements, and product data.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast\-moving, evolving environment.



**Portfolio Expectations** 




 The portfolio should include at least two detailed case studies demonstrating:
 


* The problem, user context, and business objective.
* The candidate’s specific role and level of ownership.
* Research or evidence used to guide decisions.
* Exploration of alternative solutions and relevant trade\-offs.
* Evolution from early concepts to the final experience.
* Collaboration with Product and Engineering.
* Outcomes, learnings, and post\-launch iteration.
* Examples of shipped work, where confidentiality permits.



  





**Good\-to\-Have Skills:** 



* Experience designing AI\-powered products or human–AI interactions.
* Familiarity with no\-code or low\-code platforms, workflow builders, developer tools, or cloud products.
* Experience designing data visualisations, monitoring platforms, analytics products, or administrative systems.
* Working knowledge of WCAG 2\.2 and accessibility testing practices.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and modern frontend component frameworks.
* Experience contributing to or governing a multi\-product design system.
* Familiarity with product analytics and experimentation tools.
* Experience with micro\-interactions, motion design, or advanced prototyping.
* Experience mentoring designers or leading significant design initiatives.



  





**Qualifications Criteria:** 



* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in design, Human–Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience supported by a strong portfolio will also be considered.
* Relevant certifications in product design, UX research, accessibility, or interaction design are beneficial but not mandatory.



  





**Shifts Timing, (If rotational, please specify)** 



* General Shift

**Overview:**
 The Seismic Product Design team is a diverse group of fun, hard\-working and highly collaborative people. Each designer brings a unique lens to the table to help us realize our goal of designing software that is driven by empathy and validated with data.
   

  

 Seismic continues to expand our product design team, and we're looking for a passionate and talented Product Designer to help us design and build the next generation of Seismic products. You will create beautiful and inspiring user experiences that help users create, discover, and interact with sales content managed in the Seismic platform. You are an excellent communicator, self\-starter, and collaborative enthusiast. While interaction design is the most important discipline for this role, and you likely won't be asked to redesign our entire product line, you will frequently be asked to apply our creative vision and aesthetic to new design patterns and use cases.
   

  

**Who you are:**

* 5\+ years designing for enterprise software solutions
* Passion for user\-centered design, creating powerful products that inspire and delight users
* Familiarity with a variety of both qualitative and quantitative research methods, and know how to apply them in a Design Thinking\-like process
* Comfort in a fast\-paced, highly\-dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders

* You possess expert communication skills and empathy that allows you to communicate with individuals throughout an organization


**What you’ll be doing:**

* Lead concept ideation and iteration with sketching, wire\-frame development, and prototypes

* Collaborate with product management and executives to prioritize the product roadmap

 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 The Technology Enablement Associate is a hands\-on delivery role responsible for creating and maintaining the materials, learning experiences, and operational support that help Crowe employees adopt technology effectively. Working with the Technology Enablement Leader and cross\-functional partners, the Associate turns enablement plans into polished, practical deliverables for enterprise platforms and emerging technologies, including AI, automation, analytics, and collaboration tools.
   

  

 This role is expected to own assigned deliverables from initial draft through final completion. The Associate will create content, prepare and support workshops, maintain knowledge resources, coordinate launch activities, test tools, gather feedback, and track adoption results. Work will be guided by the Technology Enablement Leader, but the Associate should be able to manage defined assignments independently, identify issues early, and recommend improvements rather than waiting for detailed direction.
   

  

 Based in India and working second shift, the Associate will collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across Crowe's global organization. Success is demonstrated through high\-quality deliverables produced on time, reliable program execution, current and usable enablement content, accurate reporting, and a positive experience for employees adopting new technology.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Produce Enablement Deliverables: Create audience\-ready presentations, user guides, job aids, FAQs, short videos, playbooks, communications, facilitator materials, knowledge articles, and other enablement assets using established standards and templates.
* Support and Deliver Learning Experiences: Prepare short video demonstrations, coordinate office hours, support learning Guilds, and community sessions; coordinate logistics, develop agendas and exercises, capture actions, and facilitate portions of sessions as experience grows.
* Execute Launch and Adoption Activities: Complete assigned activities within launch and adoption plans, including stakeholder communications, readiness checklists, training coordination, support materials, and follow\-up actions.
* Maintain Knowledge and Content Libraries: Publish, organize, review, and refresh content in SharePoint, Teams, knowledge hubs, and other repositories so users can quickly find accurate and relevant guidance.
* Test Tools and Document Use Cases: Participate in early testing of new tools and features, document workflows and business use cases, identify user experience or enablement gaps, and summarize recommendations.
* Track Adoption and Feedback: Maintain trackers and dashboards, compile survey and usage data, categorize user feedback, identify common themes, and prepare clear progress updates for Technology Enablement leadership.
* Coordinate Work and Follow\-Through: Manage assigned tasks, action logs, review cycles, deadlines, and dependencies; communicate status and risks and ensure commitments are completed.
* Collaborate Across Business and Technology: Work with Technology, Learning, Communications, Change Enablement, Business Unit teams, technical Guilds, and other partners to gather information and deliver coordinated enablement activities.
* Promote Responsible Technology Use: Incorporate approved guidance on data protection, technology risk, AI governance, and ethical use into materials and learning activities in partnership with subject matter experts.
* Continuously Improve: Stay current on relevant technology and enablement practices, incorporate feedback, and propose practical ways to improve content quality, delivery efficiency, and the employee experience.


**EXAMPLES OF EXPECTED DELIVERABLES**
* User guides, job aids, FAQs, playbooks, knowledge articles, and quick\-reference materials such as short videos
* Workshop decks, demonstrations, exercises, facilitator guides, attendance records, and follow\-up actions
* Launch communications, readiness checklists, office\-hours materials, and support resources
* Tool\-testing scripts, documented use cases, feedback summaries, and recommendations
* Adoption trackers, dashboards, survey summaries, status reports, and outcome highlights
* Content inventories, review calendars, work plans, meeting notes, and action logs


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, communications, education, organizational development, or a related field preferred. Equivalent education, training, internship, project or relevant work experience will be considered.
* Approximately 1 year of relevant experience preferred in technology enablement, digital adoption, learning, communications, technical writing, project coordination, or a related area. Internships, academic projects, volunteer experience, and portfolio work may be considered; strong entry\-level candidates are encouraged to apply.
* Should be comfortable work in 2:00 PM \- 11:00 PM IST shift
* Ability to create clear, well\-organized presentations, documents, and other materials using Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Examples may come from academic, internship, volunteer, or professional work.
* Clear written and spoken English communication skills and an interest in explaining technology concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Good organization and follow\-through, with the ability to manage assigned tasks, meet deadlines, and ask for guidance when needed.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications. Exposure to Teams, SharePoint, or similar collaboration tools is helpful but not required, with the ability to learn new platforms quickly.
* Interest in generative AI tools and emergent technology. Prior professional experience with Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools is a plus, but is not required.
* Willingness to take ownership of defined assignments, learn from feedback, raise questions, and communicate potential issues in a timely manner.
* Ability to collaborate with colleagues across teams and locations, including participation in occasional meetings across time zones based on business needs.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in public accounting, consulting, professional services, or another global corporate environment.
* Experience creating learning content, technical documentation, internal communications, demonstrations, or short instructional videos.
* Exposure to adult learning, instructional design, organizational change management, product enablement, or user adoption methods.
* Experience maintaining SharePoint sites, knowledge libraries, or content\-governance processes.
* Experience with reporting or visualization tools such as Power BI, or with project and work\-management tools such as ServiceNow Collaborative Work Management, Microsoft Planner, or Microsoft Project.
* Examples of prior work that demonstrate clear writing, strong presentation design, structured thinking, and careful execution.

 Technical Writer

 Since 2011, organizations have trusted us to provide them with a complete, market\-leading security platform built on a modern cloud stack.  Skyhigh Security Is more than a company; here, when you invest your career with us, we commit to investing in you.
